body:
Extremists like Doug LaMalfa and Ted Cruz claim to love the military, but what they actually mean is | |
---
Friend, There's a lot going on so I wanted to make sure this didn't get lost in the noise. Late last week, Republicans in the Senate _**blocked**_ the passage of the The PACT Act -- a bill that would have delivered critical resources to veterans suffering the long-term effects of burn pits. If you don't know, the toxic chemicals burned near soldiers in Iraq and Afghanistan have caused cancers and lung problems ever since -- and will only get worse as my generation of veterans gets older. The burn pit issue has been called the Global War on Terror's Agent Orange: first denied by the government, then under-resourced, and only belatedly recognized as a real problem. **That Republicans blocked this bill is the height of GOP hypocrisy.** Extremists like Doug LaMalfa and Ted Cruz claim to love the military, but what they actually mean is that they love guys with guns that they can order around. They want a parade on demand, and they're happy to vote for war after war, but they don't want to pay for the lives they've ruined. We need to pressure Republicans into passing this bill. If they get away with such open betrayal of our country's veterans, think what they will do to our constitution if given the opportunity. **[As a combat veteran, I see our soldiers as real people serving their country -- not props that serve politicians. We can do better than LaMalfa. With President Biden's approval rating at just 38%, Democrats should be in no position to win the midterm elections. However, their grassroots donor base is highly motivated and is donating almost three times as much as our conservative donors. The lack of small-dollar donations on our side puts winning back the Senate majority in serious jeopardy. If we don't act quickly and close the fundraising gap among folks who give $5, $10 and $20, we're going to lose. I don't want that, and I know you don't want that.Most importantly, America can't afford that. I don't typically read The Washington Post , but someone pointed this article out to me...and the numbers about small-dollar donations don't lie: | "Both parties are raising less than they did at this point in the 2020 presidential election, as one would expect. But Democrats are much closer to those numbers, raising about half the nearly $127 million they raised in June 2020. Republicans, by contrast, have raised less than 30 percent of their June 2020 total of $94 million." What's more, according to the same article: "Democrats in June 2022 also raised more than double what they raised during the same month in the last midterm election cycle, in 2018." body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hello everyone,

As the school year starts, I’m wishing every student a good school year. I’m rooting
for your success and your dreams.

That’s why, as the next Governor of Georgia, I will invest in education to
make sure our students are given every opportunity to succeed.

Not as a gimmick, but as a guarantee.

I will support Georgia’s students by investing in our educators — raising
teachers’ salaries, increasing pay for paraprofessionals and making sure
we put real money into education each year.

I will make sure our graduates can go into apprenticeships and technical
college for free.

And for those who go on to college, I will make sure they can get access
to need-based scholarships.

We can do all of that and more without raising a single dime in taxes. We
just need a governor who believes public education belongs to all of us.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220802_B3_School_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=10&amounts=10%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1010&akid=1282%2E1862389%2EAVaikb ]Derek, if
elected, I will be Georgia’s public education Governor — committed to
making sure Georgia’s students and their families come first. Can you chip
in as the school year starts to power my campaign for One Georgia?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220802_B3_School_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=10&amounts=10%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1011&akid=1282%2E1862389%2EAVaikb ]🍎DONATE🍎

Derek, as a
product of public schools, I know from personal experience that public
education is the blueprint for a better future.

That’s why I have a comprehensive plan that will invest in our students to
yield the results needed for healthy, thriving communities:

* → Boosting teacher pay and moving Georgia to the top 10 in teacher
salaries
* → Increasing pay for paraprofessionals so students have extra support
in the classroom
* → Increasing opportunities for post-secondary apprenticeships
* → Providing funding for free technical college
* → Ensuring access to need-based aid for college students

For our state to prosper, we will have to invest in affordable education
for our students and their families.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220802_B3_School_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=10&amounts=10%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1012&akid=1282%2E1862389%2EAVaikb ]Derek, I
need your help to make my vision for Georgia’s educational future a
reality. Can you chip in to power my campaign for One Georgia now?

Have a good school year,

Stacey

**FROM:** Chris Devaney, General Consultant and Senior Strategist
**RE:** Tennessee Congressional District 5 is in a Dead Heat
**DATE:** August 2, 2022 Team – I’m writing to share some exciting news: **new polling shows that General Winstead has the momentum in this race.** According to a new poll conducted by Spry Strategies Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District is in a **dead heat**. The poll shows a **virtual tie between Kurt Winstead and Beth Harwell** , with Andy Ogles in a distant third. You can see the poll results below. Spry Strategies predicted, almost to the number, the winner in the 2020 United States Senate Republican primary election. According to other numbers I have seen, this is another sign that **Team Winstead has the momentum heading into Election Day.** The constant negative campaigning from both Harwell and Ogles is leading to a loss in momentum and votes. While voter intensity has been down in early voting, there was an uptick in voters at the end of the early voting period this past week, as the number of undecideds appears to be dropping. As we head into election day this Thursday, August 4, urge your friends and colleagues to vote for General Kurt Winstead. Every vote will matter in this race. **LET’S GET OUT THE VOTE** Team Winstead is out in full force knocking on doors, making phone calls, texting and emailing. Kurt is barnstorming the district making stops to see as many voters as he can before election. If you would like to help us get out the vote, or work, go to our website at [kurtwinstead.com](https://kurtwinsteadgopaccount.cmail19.com/t/r-l-tykhiyky-btikuurhud-j/). |

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. name: Deirdre Gilbert
subject: Holding Accountable Election Authorities
body:
# The Challenges of an Independent Candidate
There has been some demanding challenges for me as an independent candidate, actually as a Democratic challenger as well. The truth is my candidacy was not something that the parties, yes both Republican and Democratic was looking for. I as so many women, especially black female candidates are excited about the journey to strive into the political field, until we find that our presence isn't as accepted as we would want to believe. It was my impression that Annie's List was dedicated to recruiting, training and supporting progressive women across the state of Texas. This may not be the standard conversation that many of the women who come to them are all excited about running for office, but I felt am compelled to tell the truth to my first encounter of my challenges.

I came across this article "As Texas Republicans line up for 2022
primaries, Democrats are waiting on Beto O'Rourke and redistricting."
Ms. Brooks, Executive Director of Annie's List stated that she believes whatever Beto decides to do is the domino that will affect everybody. Texas Democrats are claiming to be in an holding pattern to see if Beto will announce his run for Governor.Now I was a bit confused because Beto isn't a woman and Annie's List
claims to work with potential women candidates who are running. They were
strategizing and planning to get a man in office, while women were paying for courses and webinars. Women all across the country and so was I hoping that entities such as this would help us to achieve the goals of winning a political office.

Black women, Latino women, White women have been the loyal Democratic voting bloc in the United States. However, minority women has a uniqueness to the political behavior, but are receiving little to no attention, resources or backing from the very entities that claim to say they are there to help. It seems that black female candidates regardless of who they are have had a dissatisfaction towards the party since 2018 as to the level of engagement they provide to black candidates, yet, Democratic Black women candidates win their races or continue to run in spite of the lack of help.Shirley Chisolm says in an announcement speech that its' not just about being black. "I am not the candidate of Black Ms. America, although I am black and proud. I am not the candidate of the women's movement in this state, although I am a woman, and proud of it. I am the candidate of the people of my state.

During this challenging process it seemed that the worth of my campaign was bound in how much money I have raised at this point. That my winning ability came from someone else's preconceived thoughts of my greatness. It seems that one believed that I was unable to achieve this goal because of others limits of my ability. It seemed that the doors had been shut to my possibilities as you all they waited to see if Beto will make his decision. It seems that the political two-party system all felt that I was inadequate for a position such as this which insulted my intelligence. It seemed that they may have looked at my resume and found that I never held this type of position before, but never put faith in
me to find out if I was even capable.

I have exactly what it takes to win this race for governor and the very thing that
they system feels disqualifies me is the very thing I need.No man can talk about women's issues. No man can speak on women inequities and racial wealth gap. No man can speak on the inequities of minorities when they have always had wealth. No man can speak on healthcare when they never suffered with insurance or the ability to see a doctor. No man can talk about taking care of a disabled child and having to go on welfare to
take care of the child because of the lack of daycare options. No man
can speak on inequities of housing when they have always lived in
mansions. No man can talk about the issues of critical race theory, when
they are a part of the problem and not a part of the solution. No man
can speak of the struggle of making ends meet, when they never had to
work for minimum wage. No man can speak about voting rights when their
rights have never been challenged.

I am clearly disappointed in that I have not heard my name being spoken,
while surely you know I am running for this position. I am clearly
disappointed that not only Annie's List, but major news station, local newspaper, kept my name secret and my face obscured from public view.
I am clearly disappointed that groups that claim to help women believed that money is the rubric in which one is measured for success.

In order for us to be successful we must learn how to put our backing behind those who will do right by the people. We must build a network of women political donors that help elect more black and minority women nationwide, giving of financial resources and time, not after the primaries but before. Black women have been marginalized and had to run their races alone, until they have been deemed worthy by outside onlookers. Are you going to observe from the sidelines or will you help me win this race? It's not too late!

I've had to file lawsuits and numerous complaints of election fraud. These things should not be a part of the political system, but unfortunately it is. Texas is in need of healing. We can no longer sit idly by and watch as our educational system is destroyed, our healthcare is eliminated, our rights are choked, and our right to life and the pursuit of happiness is surrounded by chaos and destruction. We can no longer choose candidates based on a warped image of what we believe the people want. Are we wanting to just WIN, or do we want to WIN and do some great things?

We are still in litigation and am looking for final results soon as to my rights to ballot access. I need the people to stand up for what is right and to not allow the two-party system to destroy our democracy.

[Contact Secretary of State Today and Voice Your Concern!](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-nlkkkky-iduiyhurdd-r/) | 9119 Highway 6, Suite 230Missouri City, TX 77459 www.gilbert4gov.com [Preferences](https://gilbertforgovernor.updatemyprofile.com/y-nlkkkky-E305D3C8-iduiyhurdd-y) | [Unsubscribe](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-u-nlkkkky-iduiyhurdd-j/)

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60927256:J9giXkV5N:m:1:3299561967:4A18124B3F5DBBB983E269B741E9B94E:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60927256:J9giXkV5N:m:1:3299561967:4A18124B3F5DBBB983E269B741E9B94E:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60927256:J9giXkV5N:m:1:3299561967:4A18124B3F5DBBB983E269B741E9B94E:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60927256:J9giXkV5N:m:1:3299561967:4A18124B3F5DBBB983E269B741E9B94E:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60927256:J9giXkV5N:m:1:3299561967:4A18124B3F5DBBB983E269B741E9B94E:r "I hope
you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**

---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: We have our opponent
body:
Derek,
It’s official: We have our Republican opponent in Arizona. Here’s what that means for our race:
Experts all over the country agree: Arizona is going to be one of the closest races in the country this year. And now that the stage is set for November, all eyes are on us.
And with more attention comes more money. Our opponent is backed by an out-of-state billionaire in the Silicon Valley, and his Super PAC can spend virtually unlimited sums of money on this race — whatever it takes to defeat us. National Republicans, corporate special interests, and dark money groups are ready to spend millions of dollars on attack ads.
To top it all off, my opponent has the full support and endorsement of Donald Trump. So we can expect more rallies and attacks from the former president aimed at amping up his base. All the strength Trump can drum up is on its way.
I know you’ve gotten a lot of emails from me recently, but we can’t start the general election off on the wrong foot. And right now, we’re falling behind our fundraising goals.
So, please: Split a $25 contribution between our people-powered campaign and CommonGood. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220802_CGVA_Kelly]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220802_CGVA_Kelly&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220802_CGVA_Kelly&amount=35]

Donate ANy [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220802_CGVA_Kelly]
The amount isn’t as important as the donation itself, because it’s going to take A LOT of people chipping in as much as they can to reach our goal. Help us fight back and win this November.
Thank you,
Mark

We just won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate!
| | |

It's official, Peter: We just won the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate!
I am so grateful to every person who believed in our campaign and our vision for a better country. Having your trust and support is something I will never take for granted. This moment is truly the greatest honor of my life.
Our momentum is building like never before, but our opponent, Eric Schmitt, will be mobilizing powerful forces to defeat us. **I need you with me in this, Peter.[Please, can you make a donation to power this campaign all the way to November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48712682/359317447/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk167-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzkxNjNjZi0zMTEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u0Xe9CI4fhmozxxarLjiMsk6P4Nm2fv_l0j5FBEvGhg=)**
The energy on the ground is incredible – and it's all because people like you believed in my campaign and stood by me when it counted most. I am so, so grateful for everything that you've done to power this movement.
The results prove what we've been hearing on the ground for months: People are fired up to flip this seat and elect a leader who will truly deliver for their families. **Missourians have had enough of cold, partisan leadership. They've had enough lawyers and career politicians.**
Folks know that it's time for something different. And they know I'll lead with compassion and prioritize people, not partisanship. I'll listen to you and your concerns, not the lobbyists. **A nurse has never been elected to the Senate, but Washington sure could use the honesty, integrity, and problem-solving skills that we exemplify.**
Our team is ecstatic. Even still, we know this victory is only the first step. **We're taking this campaign all the way to Washington – and we've got a long road ahead of us**. Our opponent has deep-pocketed allies who will do anything to keep this Senate seat red.
**But we have something even more powerful:_you_. **By donating even just one dollar, you're powering our campaign forward and making an investment to end the opioid crisis, make daily life more affordable, and bring kindness and compassion to Washington.
**We have a big fight ahead of us, and I can't take on Eric Schmitt without you. I need your support today and every step of the way to Election Day.[So please, can you make a donation – whatever you can spare will help – to flip this seat blue and send a nurse's heart and mind to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48712683/359317448/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk167-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzkxNjNjZi0zMTEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u0Xe9CI4fhmozxxarLjiMsk6P4Nm2fv_l0j5FBEvGhg=)**

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Revealed: Plan to Transform America
body:
| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ed84fd9f5c7a4b8b897e7a3f450b5e31&_e=csLeq2xJKk07sbSaJotvSfBvEyZvr6YPfxIKrwF2JPknN4fl-K_olhK2MeBlESudJxSa1OSz949AlL8Ujnz9P1DJVgKRtEQQbPQyBljJwR_fjKnF9xf_bYJ0IdTkO1zSLDODtLEcs52jflMLKm2n8WyZRybbauxoq1Xv2FTL2PFnYWuLPAvT_kJrESyR-G_N3lvMTn-sxIbWeCfhdW-xFACL7dK6ArVMSNJLtgLxc_5aHb9ctGivPVAHDdjfS69qXbgwlZbV4kKkpJNV7j6ZyNR4o9_3vJXTG6Yhccc3bmlPzevOosZQWtAljFxMEzjW) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And what she’s discovered is startling. It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I’ve found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ our economy into something we didn’t vote on... didn’t ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we’re about to see a stranger, more extreme ‘new normal’ in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead.”** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there’s no cost to watch. Team — words cannot describe the hope and gratitude that I am feeling today!

Thanks to you, I will be the next Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Kansas. Your support leading up to this moment has meant the world to me, and I am looking forward to continuing building on this momentum together.

body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48723417/359357754/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNDAxMTJjLTQxMTMtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q02ml5AKvKoKtZ1AEOiwcraCAglfKppt6h0uVUWVIY4=&emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd40112c-4113-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, In an unexpected announcement last week, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer unveiled the most sweeping climate deal to ever reach Congress as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. If passed, this bill would set the United States on a path to lower emissions by close to 40% by 2030. We would not have made it to this moment without your advocacy and the leadership of elected climate champions throughout our nation, like Oregon’s own Senators Ron Wyden and Jeff Merkley. The U.S. Senate is voting any day now, [_**so we need to send our senators one more message thanking them for getting us here and asking them to remain steadfast in the fight to get it passed! **_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48723418/359357755/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNDAxMTJjLTQxMTMtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q02ml5AKvKoKtZ1AEOiwcraCAglfKppt6h0uVUWVIY4=&emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd40112c-4113-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) While Oregon has fierce environmental advocates in our two U.S. senators fighting for us in the battle against climate change, this is still an urgent ask— the Senate is likely to vote on this bill before the end of the week, with the U.S. House of Representatives’ vote close behind next week. What’s more, is that we will need the vote of all 50 Democratic senators to pass the Inflation Reduction Act and the incredible climate-protecting provisions it includes. [_**Will you email our senators telling them to do everything they can to pass this meaningful climate bill?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48723419/359357756/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNDAxMTJjLTQxMTMtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q02ml5AKvKoKtZ1AEOiwcraCAglfKppt6h0uVUWVIY4=&emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd40112c-4113-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) If passed, this bill would give the American people: -support and increased accessibility for renewable, electric energy options
-climate goals towards pollution-free electric vehicles that don’t produce unhealthy emissions
-reliable domestic clean energy production
-incentives to pivot from the use of fossil fuels
-investments in environmental justice communities with specific support for working families who often aren’t able to afford the shift away from fossil fuels. Democrats have spent years talking about their role opposing climate change, so now it’s time to turn those words into action by passing this comprehensive bill. Climate champions like Senators Wyden and Merkley have gotten us this far, and we can’t allow Big Oil to stop us now. [_**Let’s show our support for our senators to keep up the battle for our climate and pass the Inflation Reduction Act!**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48723420/359357757/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNDAxMTJjLTQxMTMtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q02ml5AKvKoKtZ1AEOiwcraCAglfKppt6h0uVUWVIY4=&emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd40112c-4113-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Regrettably, the details settled on between Senators Schumer and Manchin for this climate agreement aren't perfect, but thankfully, the net positives for our climate that would be achieved by passing this bill greatly outweigh the negative. As people across the world and right here in Oregon experience dangerous heat waves and extreme weather conditions, passing this historic deal on climate action can’t come soon enough. [_**Now, we must use our voices by sending a message encouraging our senators to continue spearheading impactful climate action and get this bill passed! **_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48723421/359357758/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNDAxMTJjLTQxMTMtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q02ml5AKvKoKtZ1AEOiwcraCAglfKppt6h0uVUWVIY4=&emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=cd40112c-4113-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Thank you, Doug Moore, Executive Director, OLCV |

Last night the voters of Kansas sent a strong message:
**If you let us VOTE we will vote to protect our rights!**
The Kansas referendum on the ballot yesterday was the first statewide referendum on abortion since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v Wade. The fact that, in a state Donald Trump won comfortably in 2020, voters overwhelmingly rejected a constitutional amendment that would have allowed state legislators to further restrict abortion access is a BIG DEAL.
Kansas' voters made clear that they trust women to make their own reproductive choices. And so should we. This should be a WAKE-UP call to my Senate Republican colleagues to stop blocking a vote in the Senate on the Women's Health Protection Act!
The truth is: we shouldn't be in this situation at all. Fundamental rights should not have to be decided at the ballot box. But since the Supreme Court won't stand up for fundamental reproductive freedoms or respect nearly 50 years of precedent then Americans will need to make their voices heard at the ballot box.
The results in Kansas demonstrate how important it is that we win at least two more Democratic Senate seats and end the anti-democratic filibuster that unfairly empowers senators representing an extreme minority view about abortion rights to impose their will on the overwhelming majority of the American people.
As my friend Congressman and Civil Rights leader John Lewis used to say: "The right to vote .. is the most powerful nonviolent tool or instrument in a democratic society. We must use it."
And that's exactly what we must do this November.
Onwards!
Chris

body:
| ICYMI, it's official: Paul Junge is Dan’s opponent in the general election.

Here’s three things every mid-Michigan voter should know before casting their ballot:
* **_Paul Junge is not from here, having spent 43 years outside of Michigan._** He grew up in San Diego—having graduated high school, college and law school in California. He’s lived outside of Michigan for over four decades, struggling to hold down a job in seven states and renting an apartment in Grand Blanc to run for Congress.

* **_Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress._** He has already contributed over $1 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families.

* **_Paul Junge is too extreme for mid-Michigan._** He supports a total abortion ban—with no exceptions for rape and incest. | | Hello, Public education today is failing our nation's young people-and their parents. As each generation moves on from the public school system, more and more Americans are growing unaware of our country's great history and civic traditions. But unfortunately, civics and history are too often forgotten or overlooked in the 21st century. That's why I am committed to having conversations with thought leaders around the country and providing educational resources for Americans. But an educated citizenry is essential to self-government-and the future of freedom. That's why I've issued a challenge to patriots like you to read-or re-read-the Declaration of Independence as part of our More Perfect Union Project. Because this important historical document is so rich with wisdom and eternal truths, I've asked my team at ACI to put together a helpful guide that offers a clear and exclusive analysis of this piece of history. name: Marco Rubio
subject: Peter, join me in our fight to restore the American Dream!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926993:JFI20kVNs:m:1:3253819041:DC672C39611EEB20996CE8519ED47247:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926993:JFI20kVNs:m:1:3253819041:DC672C39611EEB20996CE8519ED47247:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926993:JFI20kVNs:m:1:3253819041:DC672C39611EEB20996CE8519ED47247:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926993:JFI20kVNs:m:1:3253819041:DC672C39611EEB20996CE8519ED47247:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926993:JFI20kVNs:m:1:3253819041:DC672C39611EEB20996CE8519ED47247:r "5")
---

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkvmk3rf846u7kgb16c6pgenvf42ovks1o8b42qg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onnc5jj9ppmcoonfdb1caombctnmqrj1dlj68rmcdhle6rj8dlleeob6sb26con1puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmkq3fchkcoon9ddgcuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmgqdf2rjlo6mmljv3513s72511hk77d4jta4vmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5scrp9mqvreja8mc7df90qrdfucc81ll5glu82o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zb4feoi2k46d51t1pjr9km2l1t57s3g4nvmrpv88_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbhahm6q15pt0438g5n7shke8497vq26i2uejpuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi2h8g4la4nj7o1ll9t5mnng5p6ukvec6qtsl35o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zp47nlfhqd2kqvftnuunpfe9jh3popri9hir8gj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znes7sh4rgtf3vorftol25sgmfulnoruhaget1s8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcuuo8vkrgh184kt1bppq2gljfq32pue1hno8nrg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zfaidik13go4av6aqbql8sgonfg1qmqefatogqk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z74kjldgbskoqau05kst0tuiede4n8g7nalc5pb8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z4s3t2mvb9o60o54h6kenmoitincs7t8360nvq8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ze5igfcbl11lsmlv3kbk9phj4d6c86l8udd7h970_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk4rrrn9uii0k41kqutapv2puum5ljk7nuecnbu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z309ikrvjhanrlet3erkl8vji4o4fqccn5782a70_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zaosgdu5ocgmobhs8safg2haufitg4l33m57nns8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqmqn5jde0rhq79j85qa0ev7j3r9s8e0d03llhqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdei47plsssc1msqkauevt197nvt2lugu8shikoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zn74survbm8clogp9ti72660ijdrir2kjlucpnfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slgm2pr5c1h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for Deroy Murdock, . 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

name: Katie Hill
subject: My new op-ed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the HER Time PAC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/uAHXHaYjJKzwgZag0HU4nKOFmbvwAQb0SX9Y6aiEIKA=/yI-lzxQgPCwjuNPQo33rcp8MR5kPBgSjoes_4fVnGnI=)
---
When Donald Trump was elected, we feared it would be the end of _Roe v Wade. _When Brett Kavanaugh was appointed, we knew conservatives would have enough votes to get their way. And when the _Dobbs_ opinion leaked in May, our worst fears were confirmed.
But _ NONE_ of that compared to how it felt when _Roe _was actually overturned.
In [my new op-ed in Teen Vogue](https://act.myngp.com/el/uAHXHaYjJKzwgZag0HU4nKOFmbvwAQb0SX9Y6aiEIKA=/yZlFOmajJgr5mRJMQEcqlaRTM7h-lwRbuGoZcRvn6d8=), I talk about that day -- and all the awful days since.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/uAHXHaYjJKzwgZag0HU4nKOFmbvwAQb0SX9Y6aiEIKA=/SY1jUWN7osxFIx9aCKQ2Bk_btiPMzDZ2f1FrV6JmNEc=)
**At HER Time, we knew that action in November wouldn 't be enough. So we made [the HER Time Guide to a Post-Roe World](https://act.myngp.com/el/uAHXHaYjJKzwgZag0HU4nKOFmbvwAQb0SX9Y6aiEIKA=/8qvfxjvtsQbZsvYHMA5BY0pSuRMwmjPTkm49dNvehq8=). It includes two different manuals: one for women looking for safe and reliable abortion resources and one for folks trying to take action for abortion rights.**
You'll hear a lot more about our action guide in weeks to come. body:
I vow to continue this fight for a fair democracy for all.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48729470/359382508/-532505380?refcode=EM_C_220803Miguel_N_MTO_90DO_5_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzI0ODNmNi01MDEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O9UCYLzjnOQjvOK30VOqthHg1ggWce4HG1apTWkPsoo=)
Today, I am excited to honor and announce the posthumous winner of the 2022 Margaret Chase Smith American Democracy Award for Political Courage, _Miguel H. Trujillo_. He will be rewarded at the NASS 2023 Winter Conference in Washington, D.C.

During the recent 2022 National Association of Secretary of State Conference, I nominated Trujillo for the Margaret Chase Smith American Democracy Award. Out of at least 50 other submissions, Trujillo was selected to be the recipient – and rightfully so.

Miguel H. Trujillo was a tribal educator and former Marine Staff Sergeant who used the legal system to fight for Native Americans’ right to vote in New Mexico. Over 70 years ago, he challenged a provision in the New Mexican constitution that prevented Native Americans from voting. He won this fight in 1948 when a District Court deemed this prohibition on Native Americans living in New Mexico as unconstitutional. To this day, Pueblo Indians credit Trujillo for winning them the right to vote.

In 2022, BIPOC communities are still fighting for their rights in a land that was once completely Indigenous. There are many reasons I submitted Miguel H. Trujillo for this award – his courage, passion and commitment to his identity just to name a few. Most of all, he fought to make democracy work for all citizens of New Mexico, which is why I consider him one of my biggest heroes.

_I vow to do right by Miguel H. Trujillo, and continue this fight for a fair democracy for all._

Sincerely,

Maggie Toulouse Oliver

She's up for re-election in 2022, and we need to start building our grassroots movement to keep her seat safe. **Help Maggie protect our elections system and create a stronger democracy! name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6210%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aJbKcgGYkP1A0h5a55%2fx8g&sysid=1)
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64108%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iatRDtJStr6mnru80%2f2%2fmA&sysid=1)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64109%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fDWvNCQ74WpUPJ7NBNJzcA&sysid=1)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64100%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qGmY0ufeiJcW8BOYu42Oiw&sysid=1)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64101%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gT2TlRLM4%2fXi3UKzkJFDFA&sysid=1)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64102%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qa6MMINlPFReYstEWIhp7w&sysid=1)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64103%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1rguh2ld1Tx8d1N%2fUgVwbg&sysid=1)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64104%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a8cY6oMa%2fTOUd8X6baWF%2fA&sysid=1)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT’s events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64115%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3j11P0i2ZenYUVULgsSkHQ&sysid=1)

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64116%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fqlTfIL9NwKSA9g%2bJL%2fDIA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64117%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pqMzTrMTgzxqgavwvio%2b8A&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64118%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TGzIR91jbkzihZg7Gz1F%2bg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64119%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6%2fiSzMiUPR7wPucU23rLRQ&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64110%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xVgMRiD7j1oOwx0%2fUu6opg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64111%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xCEflGP5%2fTaobjzI8ro0Ow&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64112%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nLgjndqX28Virlf%2f55b7mg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64113%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nWYdU6LWuRjd4d2u7ZjNWw&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64114%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hJ6LqKZjuO3CmELjN5VCNA&sysid=1)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64125%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eWx92hYblQF%2fYCEA%2fcfZrQ&sysid=1)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation
_107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6210%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aJbKcgGYkP1A0h5a55%2fx8g&sysid=1)_

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation 107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314

Friend,
Last night, our veterans overcame a major hurdle in securing the care they need and deserve. The Senate came together to pass the heavily bipartisan PACT Act , a prime example of how our government is support work for the people
However, just last week this SAME bill was blocked by 25 Senators, including James Lankford. While 14 of these Senators reversed course, Lankford and 10 other Senators voted ‘NO’, yet again , to provide the health care services that our veterans deserve.
I am running to guarantee veterans across the country are not thrown aside by party politicians. Will you join in our fight to protect our veterans? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh?refcode2=e78b9b1c-5813-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a]
Taking care of our veterans should not be a partisan issue. These brave men and women have endured hardships many of us could not even imagine. They were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice for us, the least we can do is protect them when they return home.
Lankford’s refusal to provide care for veterans leaves more questions than answers. Who DOES James Lankford represent? Certainly not our veterans. Undoubtedly he does not advocate for women, our workers, or the American voters – which was apparent when he fought to overturn the 2020 Election.
Let’s be very clear, Lankford only represents himself and has lost his moral standing - he does not represent the people who elected him into office. I am fighting to represent all Oklahomans, and I need your help! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh?refcode2=e78b9b1c-5813-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a]

Our opponent is backed by an out-of-state billionaire in Silicon Valley, and his super PAC can spend virtually unlimited sums of money on this race — whatever it takes to defeat us.

It’s official. We have our Republican opponent in Arizona. Here’s what that means for our race:
Experts all over the country agree that Arizona is going to be one of the closest races in the country this year. And now that the stage is set for November, all eyes are on us.

Peter,

Democrats just can’t seem to let go of their COVID theatrics.

COVID opened the door for the Left to test the limits of just how much they can get away with. First it was mandatory lockdowns. Then it was mandatory masks. Next it was mandatory vaccines. Then it was double masks. Followed by double vaccines.

subject: GREAT Grant Awarded
body:
Expands Broadband Access in Transylvania County
---

---
|
---
| PRESS RELEASE Senator Chuck Edwards
---
| |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE August 3, 2022
---
| Contact: [Heather Millett](mailto:heather.millett@ncleg.gov) (919) 733-5745
---
| | |
---
| Transylvania County to Receive $4 Million for Rural Broadband Expansion More than 1,500 households and businesses set to receive high-speed internet.
---
| | |
---
| Raleigh, N.C. - Sen. Edwards (R-Henderson) is proud to announce that Transylvania County is set to receive $4 million to expand access to high-speed internet.
The funding comes from the Growing Rural Economics with Access to Technology (GREAT) grant program. In the 2021 state budget, the General Assembly allocated an additional $350 million to the grant program to support a new round of grants.
Senator Edwards said, "I'm excited to know that due to our work in the legislature, almost 1,600 more rural Transylvania County households can soon enjoy the modern benefits of internet connectivity."
The GREAT grant program funding will ensure ZiTel, LLC can begin work to deploy high-speed internet to approximately 1,572 households and businesses across Transylvania County.
This round of GREAT grants leverages federal funds from the American Rescue Plan Act to provide matching grants to internet service providers and electric membership cooperatives that may partner with counties to expand access to broadband internet in underserved areas of the state.

I want to have the chance to say thank you, directly, for all that you do
for my campaign and in your communities.

Georgia.

Stacey

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsedqmk944h32gb2rpn0c0qr7bugb141j7o4n5n0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim8ob2c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. body:
In order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.
#
Right now, we’re building one of the biggest organizing programs Texas has ever seen so we can make history and elect Beto as our next Governor.

Team Beto volunteers have already accomplished some amazing things. **But in order to turn out a historic number of voters on Election Day, we need all hands on deck.**

We’re reaching out to you because our campaign needs your help to make direct, personal contact with as many Texans as we can.
[**Will you sign up today to write letters to Texans and help build support for Beto?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52815?utm_source=ema20220803-201294&t=1&akid=201294%2E444211%2E1YzKt9) You'll have the opportunity to meet other supporters after a brief training. Plus, our letter-writing events are hosted virtually, so you can join us from anywhere.
**[Write letters for Beto »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52815?utm_source=ema20220803-201294&t=2&akid=201294%2E444211%2E1YzKt9)**
Winning in Texas won't be easy, especially with the extreme voter suppression happening right in front of our eyes. But we know that we're capable of generating once-in-a-lifetime voter turnout if we put in the work right now.
Thank you for being part of this,
Katherine Fischer
Organizing Director, Beto for Texas
