body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkrk1ocecvo7lgi176ngf8a2d0r7s8uo0d0rck4o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim4pj4cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6s356kqr2o3n6eqnbdj1cpj7ccjnmsoe8cthmgon5c75chh38d3kcth78sblmsrt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcsdkmmom0slhcooj1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhf5351sak5r0716t11vq6lvg5fq9r1dl923qp0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim4pj4cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Dear Friend,

It is election season!

A time of year that really lends itself to reflecting on the ways each of us can take a more active role in our communities, and it starts with making your voting plan leading up to Primary Election Day on September 6th.

First step to making your voting plan is taking a look at all the important dates.
July/August: Submit your vote by mail application
August 27th: Voter Registration Deadline for MA Primary
August 29th*: Vote by Mail Application Deadline *We encourage sending applications 7-10 days earlier than this deadline to ensure you receive your ballot and send it back in time to be counted.)
August 27 - September 2: Early Voting, times and location vary town to town. Check your town/city's election page closer to the early voting period to find out your early voting options.
Tuesday, September, 6th: MA Primary, polls will be open 7am - 8pm. All mail in ballots need to be received by your local election by 8pm on this day.
The next step to make your voting plan is to figure out what voting method makes sense for you. This year we have three ways to vote:

1. Vote by mail. After 30 other states (including GA and TX) granted the right, decades of advocacy by our voting rights community, and a global public health pandemic, in July 2022 voters in Massachusetts finally secured the right to vote by mail with no excuse. If you have not received your vote by mail application, you can submit a signed letter to your election office requesting a ballot. This is a great option for those who might be traveling the long weekend ahead of the Primary, do not have the time or means on a weekday to get to your polling location, or are just not sure what their day will look like on Sept. 6th.

2. Early Voting (in person). Once again, the primary was scheduled for the day after Labor Day- September 6th. This is a tough day for many families and working people. In some communities it’s the first day of school. But this election is too important to have your voice left out, so please consider voting early. The early vote period August 27th through September 2nd. Check with your local election office to confirm the early voting locations in your community.

3. Election Day (in person). TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 6TH is our state primary day this year. Although it can be a tough day for many people following the holiday weekend and with preparations for the start of school, this primary election Is too important to sit out. Decisions impacting the future of Massachusetts will be made on this day, and you have a say in that future by casting your vote. Do not miss this opportunity. If you are in line at your polling location by 8pm your vote will be counted, so stay in line!

In each instance, If you are a registered Democrat, you will receive a Democratic ballot. If you are an unenrolled voter you will be given the opportunity to choose which ballot you want. I am asking you to choose the Democratic ballot and to vote for me.

To be ready to vote, please confirm your voter registration status, especially for those who have or are planning to move this month. On my website there is a link that will direct you to a site where you can register to vote and check your registration status at the bottom of the homepage. Unfortunately, Massachusetts does not have same day voter registration like other New England states so you have to be registered by August 27th. When I am Secretary of State we will work together to ensure Massachusetts voters have the same voting rights as voters in 20 other states across the country...we will find our way to YES on same day or election day registration!!

Thank you for your vote!!

Tanisha

Early Voting (in person). Once again, the primary was scheduled for the day after Labor Day- September 6th. This is a tough day for many families and working people. In some communities it’s the first day of school. But this election is too important to have your voice left out, so please consider voting early. The early vote period August 27th through September 2nd. Check with your local election office to confirm the early voting locations in your community. 3. Election Day (in person). TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 6TH is our state primary day this year. Although it can be a tough day for many people following the holiday weekend and with preparations for the start of school, this primary election Is too important to sit out. Decisions impacting the future of Massachusetts will be made on this day, and you have a say in that future by casting your vote. Do not miss this opportunity. If you are in line at your polling location by 8pm your vote will be counted, so stay in line! In each instance, If you are a registered Democrat, you will receive a Democratic ballot. If you are an unenrolled voter you will be given the opportunity to choose which ballot you want. I am asking you to choose the Democratic ballot and to vote for me. To be ready to vote, please confirm your voter registration status, especially for those who have or are planning to move this month. On my website there is a link that will direct you to a site where you can register to vote and check your registration status at the bottom of the homepage. Unfortunately, Massachusetts does not have same day voter registration like other New England states so you have to be registered by August 27th. When I am Secretary of State we will work together to ensure Massachusetts voters have the same voting rights as voters in 20 other states across the country...we will find our way to YES on same day or election day registration!! Thank you for your vote!! Tanisha Donate [] [] [] [] Paid for by the Committee to Elect Tanisha M. Sullivan Committee to Elect Tanisha M. Sullivan P.O Box 320008 Boston, MA 02132 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

# Leftist Policies are at Fault

| | |
---|---
|
The U.S. economy is faltering due to leftist policies; it is time for Republicans to take charge.
Coloradans, and all Americans, deserve Congressional leadership that understands how to foster economic prosperity. And yet, the current President and Congress have repeatedly let us down.
Inflation is stifling growth and eroding our purchasing power at a [pace not seen in 40 years](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId40hC9YvULfoafFuXHt9SH9FMlZPmysYUltBWfEzDWu-B2XgkcT_aRawdwW0LWPMcd1Vczt4IqSdUjsPVZM1Bw6R_7m3SEfjpZHS9CluGEOe9Do7Nvcxf8A2vKVGivXkKot1VnqThJO-We0Fyx1nGU9ESuoIoWs_tvTtv4lhjVsxy6vh7cqowQQhzL-eox-qktZ7gOKo1ju1UyQqYWkh1kCAqENL3aoZ51&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==). [Gasoline prices](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4mJCUl0cSQpaDOXTurKTVYHBm4ffB_f3fsavE6R-uCd6j55IBjW_k0QkNpOZngXtTtvaFxsPMG8Di8AX6Dd3MG4ruuheSgGOZlLcFuasOywdWpw8Pnj7rTZ2_FcQ1JtfxXjxHJx5PByWfXWPdoiXUac3zv1OpaT4zVzIsCxTYc2iCSzO3n-2jRw==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==), despite recent drops, continue to be much higher than just a year ago. [Jobless claims](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4FjKwF1vrmRDANlngczXnR5K5kaCzIB-DlEzKgH2SN2XVLr02TCuD5KYT0ZMcFmNJE-Tzt-ZXLaYKqH0RX0OeAQyWN7bgpFbSyE4OopNl565T3owtE0vkPhqRJTLrJWcvM5wOvWZSGf0tRSi4x82Mfc5OIHPHE7mtfSJ9_EQ3T6g=&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==) are rising. New home construction is [declining](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4a4_dybgx-o95Zre_H2MGtGVt5Pgss9u-oLEOv3mQpRE2DMbSMRaK0VYrhp5nOBMrqbcfV7v2e3jpI9fnKmLNrDu4kePKSnNAN8Kh61bRWq2YLV94SXNwBjR_I0-3lcUqFwac1B7lRie7lJtzuAATYzdlPYJ8pzKdRqXMxhCNE22vp23Fastw49R4ygvU1c80OAHSHKfQ1DY=&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==).
| | |
---|---
|
We find ourselves in [a recession](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4mXAGzvGLH1WoEMuglkr2GYEgcpKDGCsz9R6XYRdpgCK-bmISd2Myx5KjY3JdaINvQoBAAYpysndddw4NUjOSr0BIBi-Yhx5U58rDsq6c7G21gJ3TmCCtwMc9uipZvJ7FSIuH_Io-ES3Mj97f8c2KAaXXsiqjIRUlnSn8BNal5E5aX8MkVr1ISw==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==), with a President who uses semantics to [deny the obvious](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4Xdl3Gk1Q8Whru8K4eI8Kt5-VWY62oefmXTrtEeH4Pfl7f0LDk35t96_4ZcSLrTuJMhCBbFRTrRKkIEO5TUlF9R_P3je4yuoMOLpb_TOBKRYczGUloVU0v3FFCKxv7q8IQrHJ_wQw0p1ARtOWPwKtjr4_hx-Z6byK&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==). The radicals behind him are attempting to "revise" the decades-old [definition of a recession](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId48mmddgcrGCuT2U3chFpod3v_B-8AckAvUe6_nuZcBrClrc8CsTkufmTbkLzJcZUheDG6Dw577ejpvwfPX7tA9ELhmVW9hHB2hko7dNcRx0TwJoi68K_ypiCK1UcrpKK68wLB02v2WtR44ClzuhE6sRWt9kB3AUOZ9PC0hTjO3W6lW-FLqLANWd4BpVdKhwd5TcmDi_KPZWw=&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==), and some [notable names in the media are even helping](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4k0u6I7Y360LLZOF9MebdVjsjNIn4DuIeyqvUwMUzD3J9FPbQkpWhDV9hwM_sD8CUISX37nu1_Tzjq7FVBn-pB7dw1XjqQi4PJqUCN-ru6R49OHd7UUJKC7QQ-LrrVO_YH8zX9WrFpQh4mS98DDgDCK_ONqvS88y27dBol5zCddx2-YIUJdDrtwYV_PzGs3Wj&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==) the President advance this false narrative.
How can we reduce inflation and end the recession despite this malicious confusion? The first part of solving any problem is to accept the truth: the recession is real, and Americans already know it. The second part is to embrace proven and practical solutions.
| |
---|---
|
We know the radical Democrats' answer: spend, spend, spend.
The government-first solutions in their misleadingly named "[Inflation Reduction Act of 2022](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4H6lbSRLxdHam_8jQ23iLmnsKUCL461xwqZvME-y6NUgvuSjLE5UklMRfc_medqTv0HCRAkgQsG6ikVHN0oDefvm9i2fU0ZeUzOM4bCx4zBmLBJMIoPjYwxDo2ULAv4yFnu469grwyYE3ZDZbR1Lxdr-s8WHJ1jRA1o1k13gsJ55E00q3gqBLCA==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==)" include: raising corporate taxes--the cost of which will be simply passed on to consumers--and increasing the number of IRS agents, imposing prescription drug price fixing, and plowing more money into climate change mandates that regressively benefit the already rich. And those are merely the "highlights". Does this spending spree really sound as though Democrats are focused on solving problems? Ideology clearly is more important to them than the plight of the American taxpayer.
If elected, Brittany Pettersen will only fall in line with the Democrat machine's unrealistic schemes, alongside her far-left colleagues Nancy Pelosi and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Coloradans deserve better representation, and America deserves a better way of doing business.
What are our answers?
Cut spending. One practical way of reducing spending is to eliminate Congressional earmarks--again. In 2011, [House Republicans eliminated the practice](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4pn4HpCZRreHVMhVo7WjC6WH7f3rd8l0bTyRM45yezuV8IVIkpxn82UyV5gwII1IlKBiEpFC4P3c2OVHNBAws009OrT88QpOLezaOuKwDvsuJJhL_AbvsA5jyv18HNd9dl0TtYoZqVNsjlsFI7eZ-VOwcKTPFcJuKY8ZQZqlxuyoWfay0pUs9cQ==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==) of earmarks, which allowed individual members to plug in specific legislation for projects in their districts. Earmarks were often abused by both parties, resulting in needless, wasteful spending on dubious projects. Unfortunately, [the Democrats have resurrected earmarks](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4gSqWBMtRpPWz-dpr9IE6K9kXmyJVe9Sd5-79BnczDLuQjccKjgoS64cdQIPpsh4th2hHiNaIILUVPww2ThXN2zS1Ot1zwDjpnreXCoIlwuKe7TGw65BJGdLXLaO97ul-4fcU6qBTZNDFQHfoyUI5Pyo-SWvLhJsMIfm0810bFc_uAgwS2aHmbPqlnskcvb8H&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==) and, as expected, wasteful spending has returned.
| | |
---|---
|
Cut taxes. Increased corporate taxation has no proven history of success in improving the economy. If the government chooses to pillage businesses, the net effect will be higher prices to consumers and those who can least afford it.
Furthermore, President Ronald Reagan cut individual taxes when he inherited an inflationary economy from Jimmy Carter. This "[kick-started an extraordinary economic recovery](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4n9By0OJXMqo3c_wQIWR67mkrO7jqx23LunzoStVLEvmB4ALhYQ9xLJzqJ13L0qYMiOWpi--udNhaNKkvPYMAfnZW7028bPFWZp2v9EvopvdIFSXMCYRsUIZIfRDNL2p9VEzTgdg_VsShsUoJzwNf21JGnvPQuZ8d0V12zdeGr-QLvxo7ZMLUvg==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==) following the malaise of the Carter era. Tax rates were lowered further with the Tax Reform Act of 1986."
President Donald Trump [followed a similar path](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4TEq7QOmsJI9mxhJdFNyAgyDho4brYsny7qM2Lh9vYc4VBFCBeGkmiBWE8FNrCDLxMWrRDZ08nKKdLr5y68cvZeW5Ciu8yWT_YwLpuJxbKUkydvLwMCjJTVCgGerrKI8oylEH_tSDrzg=&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==), reducing not only individual tax rates, but also cutting corporate taxes, ending the Obamacare penalty, and doubling the standard deduction. The upshot? A soaring economy, low inflation, a booming stock market, and record low unemployment.
Return to a state of energy independence. The Biden administration's radical leftist agenda is intent on moving the nation away from fossil fuels. They are so dedicated to their "green platform" that they have [erected roadblocks to oil & gas exploration](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V7Io6koNngD2JBnAdXaistYPQAzi0h9heeqW891mmF4l82LyHyOqGTvQRUScBId4svNPLvvzHFoyRC7EuaG8XU_4ZrOkY7PeGvbBRJ9ZbZpYL5Z7RGxFjYIvTCD-pAyEygNrAvm7JIdhsA_cZwTbllOk6qmMyqYWy7Lcv97blFvPE_h-yvi617aBK93n-397EJzIodFW-ZmqkzmsNXW0jQ57ARXZLElKobB6_TcCNjPLjjPkVRTCFOjw6oAJ48zTeAT-6hm0CtMUeuEkL3qwy60ClX1CNvJDAuq1WTnnuGSVvjWIFB98nQ==&c=thEU83HBMEM4qnSC6QFGKEy1dRr8KB2TALM7RAj31Bi0QTXHwdrVvw==&ch=Lb33aUKXCEBEnuwhcOsjRK27Mt-nxlhtDyMI3sy6375_uuouZT-wWA==), use of federal lands, and permits for extraction. They also saw fit to cancel the Keystone XL pipeline, which forced American energy companies to decrease production.

# Kemper Failure Produces More Planning
---
| What do Instacart, Juul vapes, and wireless earbuds have in common?

They were virtually unheard of just ten years ago. [Consumer](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=3d932dd2df&e=5703353baa) choice is just one of those things that cannot be fully predicted by models and analyses. Did you ever think that we’d have self-driving cars or delivery robots?

As Freidrich [Hayek ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=e5551d7f86&e=5703353baa)said, “If a man is not to do more harm than good, he will have to learn that...he cannot acquire full knowledge which would make mastery of all events possible.”

Here in Mississippi though, the [Public](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=ea7f5b51a5&e=5703353baa) Service Commission forces publicly owned utility companies to engage in “demand-side management” whereby customers are incentivized to modify their level and pattern of electricity usage.

In essence, instead of building more plants to meet demand, utility companies opt to alter the demand.

These demand calculations are based on the erroneous assumption that we can quantify consumer preferences, which in reality are [subjective](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=a18625b152&e=5703353baa).

Before we discuss the ramifications of demand-side management, let’s backup a step and contextualize what we are talking about.

In the aftermath of the failed [Kemper](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=552cf635c1&e=5703353baa) project, the Public Service Commission sought to create more transparency and stakeholder engagement in utility companies. In 2019, Mississippi became one of the 30+ states to mandate integrated resource plans. Although well-intentioned, the utility companies immediately fought back, attempting to [bar ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=f22e708d3c&e=5703353baa)third parties from submitting data requests.

An IRP serves as a roadmap for a utility company, analyzing how it plans to respond to inflation, capital costs, environmental externalities, and changes in consumer load. The system is called “integrated” because it analyzes both supply and demand, unlike traditional plans which exclude the latter.

In Mississippi, utility companies are required to use twenty-year planning periods and must submit an updated IRP every three years.

Have IRPs achieved their intended goal of meeting consumer needs and providing more transparency?

Well, the supply-side reporting makes sense, but demand-side planning actually causes harm to consumers.

[Demand](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=79e350d1d3&e=5703353baa)-side management is advertised as a way to save consumers money but is actually a thinly veiled political tool. DSMs began in the 1980s as a response to climatologists' warning of manmade climate change.

In fact, the theory of IRP is not grounded in any kind of scholarly work - it wasn’t researched and then implemented but implemented and then researched.

Had the bureaucrats done this in the proper order, one of the problems they would have found is that “efficient” energy is neither cheaper nor more efficient.

It’s not cheaper because, as [Matthew Hoffman says](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=853959f5c6&e=5703353baa), utility companies lose revenue by incentivizing consumers to install green technology. For example, if electricity for an incandescent bulb is $15 per year, a DSM planner may estimate that the same energy can be provided by a fluorescent bulb for $5 a year, plus the $8 cost of the bulb, totalling $13. Seems like a win-win situation, right?

Not exactly. Whereas the company used to generate [$15 ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=1f82f5ca25&e=5703353baa)per customer per year, it now makes $5 (a loss of $10). It also spent $8 on the bulb, so its net loss is $18. No company would willingly plan to lose profits so the Public Service Commission allows them to raise their rates.

Pye and Nadel (1994) discovered that DSM programs increase electricity prices by a median of 1.7% per year. Proponents say that’s negligible, but isn’t that for the consumer to decide?

What ends up happening is that [every consumer](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=3db6ba95b1&e=5703353baa), whether he installed a fluorescent light bulb or not, pays more for electricity. Efficient electricity serves as a hidden tax, forcing consumers to pay more in order to feel good about themselves. [DSM ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=e62048b4df&e=5703353baa)costs are significantly higher than projected costs.

In a free market, we would call this a sham.

And of course, the [Total Resource Cost](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=8c4f66e490&e=5703353baa) test (which measures efficiency) leaves out this hidden cost, making DSMs seem cost-effective. A shocking example of this is Camden Wire which “received $740 is DSM rebates” but incurred [$150,000](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=aa425bfa77&e=5703353baa) in DSM charges.

Other hidden costs include imperfect information, infrastructure,[ two-way](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=bdbd365767&e=5703353baa) communication systems, smart meters, and a multitude of non-monetary losses.

Hoffman provides two examples of this: insulation worsens humidity which leads to increased ventilation and “efficient” air-conditioners reduce the dehumidification function which leads to one of two things: decreased comfort or longer usage. This is what we call the [rebound ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=d8e65fd146&e=5703353baa)effect.

So either, the efficiency will be completely offset, or the consumer will suffer in the 100-degree Mississippi summers.

Just like solar energy, DSMs are just a way for energy companies to make profits while inviting customers to feel good about fulfilling some social responsibility.

In a free-market, such scams would be shut down instantly. Instead of reducing government oversight, both Republicans and Democrats are championing its [continuance](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=7d4503a986&e=5703353baa), believing that the[ government ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=a94ed05ebb&e=5703353baa)knows what’s best for ratepayers.

Friend, it's hard to believe that we're less than 100 days out from Election Day.
When I first made the decision to run for Senate, I knew this race would be one of the toughest I've ever faced. **And at its core, my campaign has always been about making the people I love proud. **
Growing up poor, Black and female in the 1960s South meant that I didn't have a whole lot – but I did have unconditional love. Sometimes I wonder who I would be and what I would be doing if I didn't have a family who was determined to make me shine at all costs.
Because the truth is, if my father hadn't taken an advance out on his paycheck to send me on a school trip to D.C., if my mother had never told me to "never tire of doing good," if I hadn't had the support system of my six older siblings, all of my success may not have been possible.
**So friend, this campaign started as part of my mission to never tire of doing good and as a way to make my loved ones proud – but now it's about more than that.**

In 2013, when we started our work to make our communities safer from gun violence, there were three issues Gabby prioritized:
#

Friends -
In 2013, when we started our work to make our communities safer from gun violence, there were three issues Gabby prioritized:
Universal background checks, limiting the sale of high capacity magazines, and an assault weapons ban.
The response from many Democrats was a gasp and a “you can’t talk about those issues on the campaign trail!”
Fast forward almost a decade and Democrats are running and WINNING on the issue of gun violence prevention. Last year, the House passed universal background checks for the second time. And the House even took up—and passed—a bill that bans assault weapons and high capacity magazines months before an election just a few days ago.
That would have been unthinkable not long ago.
But the truth is, that progress has happened because public opinion on this issue has shifted dramatically. And voters are choosing candidates with the courage to fight against the gun lobby and for our safety. Our work at Giffords is a big part of that.
So if you want universal background checks, if you want limits on high capacity magazines, and if you want that assault weapons ban, we’re fighting to make it happen every day.
But we can’t do it alone. Donations in response to emails like this have funded our work literally from day one. And it’s why we’re asking:

Electing state Democrats is one of the _only_ things we can do right now to expand and protect abortion access now that the Supreme Court has opened the floodgates for state Republicans’ abortion bans with the _Dobbs_ decision. body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmrqleubcbsdmh7ldh9bhjght87779ec3go075o8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf0p1nmtib1ob6clgeapplchg74ttgmcrm4t3kc9h62s5ic5j61dj2e1im2obicsrt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcsdkmmq3fdj1copb1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim9pb5clg68p724no)
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8f20di0tfksn8bue1umqkehuov94ebm0ej6sq2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs)

Friend,

Donald Trump said back in 2015 that many of the illegal immigrants coming to America were not the best people from their countries-and he was right.

In April of this year, Avellaneda Anselmo was arrested for selling cocaine in a small town in North Carolina.

Around the same time, three different illegal aliens by the names of Juan Jose Miranda Valencia, Lorenzo Miranda, and Victor Reyes-Mariano were busted with drugs they allegedly intended to sell.

In a 24-hour period, half a dozen illegal immigrants were arrested for drunk driving in one of North Carolina's "sanctuary counties."

_And I wish that was the worst of it._

In Virginia, three illegal immigrants (Yang Gao, Ye Wang and Si Liu) were arrested for running a human trafficking ring.

Last month, police arrested Andre Rolando Ramos on multiple child porn charges.

Just a few short weeks ago, U.S. Border Patrol apprehended Isaias Pulido-Alvarado – a drug dealer AND child rapist – who only served a measly year for his crimes in Wisconsin before being released.

**And the Biden administration wants these people to stay here.**

We're fighting back against this administration's horrific policies which basically allow felons to remain in the United States indefinitely, but we need your help.

[**Which is why I'm asking you to send an urgent gift of $35 or more right now to the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI).**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zo2ju9mmm1sb8atm5vnarkn9iinbba7ljh5jvr40_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs)

_That's right._

Under these new policies, it's next to impossible to deport KNOWN criminals like this - no matter how heinous their crimes.

**If you want to do everything in your power to stop them, I need you to read this letter from beginning to end.**

The states of Texas and Louisiana are suing the Biden administration over their plummeting standards for deporting criminal aliens – and the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) has filed briefs in the case alongside them to assist the court, and I have provided hours of expert testimony at the trial.

These briefs are an important part of the legal process that inform the judge about our case. They can make the critical difference between a win or a loss in court.

The good news is that we won the trial...

_...but the bad news is this fight is just beginning._

The Biden administration has immediately appealed the outcome and is going to fight this with everything they have – and we need to be prepared.

[**That's why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation to IRLI right away**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z205ger2eohm66f364cnphf40ro9dvr3ht6vj0qo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs), **to give us the ammunition we need to uphold the rule of law not just in Texas and Louisiana, but across our country.**

My name is Tom Homan, and I'm the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) under President Trump and now a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

I know firsthand what's going on at our border – and just how hard this administration is making it for Border Patrol and ICE to do their jobs.

In all my years, I've never seen anything like this.

We can protest, we can send petitions, we can call our Senators...

But if we really want to bring the anti-borders agenda to a screeching halt, our best course of action is taking them to court.

**That's why I joined IRLI - an incredible legal team created to fight for the American people, uphold our rule of law, and stop bad immigration policies.**

They have proven themselves time after time.

Every time they've taken on the Biden administration, they've won - and that's thanks to patriots like you.

You see, while IRLI's attorneys get results, they still face a constant uphill battle against anti-borders groups funded by billionaires like George Soros.

And when IRLI's attorneys take on a case – like the briefs filed in the Texas and Louisiana case for example – and spend hours upon hours devising legal strategy, they don't charge a dime.

They aren't in it for the pay day.

They take on these cases because they know just how important they are.

_They know that without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing._

[**If you understand just how important IRLI's work is, I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjafvj6jg0ph10sndb0qj23oddpfqnfim46b4h7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs)

The United States of America must deport criminal aliens.

That's the law, and we're fighting tooth and nail to uphold it.

The truth is, I wouldn't be surprised if this goes all the way up to the Supreme Court

Don't forget, the Biden administration wants criminal illegal aliens right here, on your side of the border, in your communities, doing what they want when they want.

IRLI won't stand for this – and I hope you won't either.

Sincerely,
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zq62a26qfapcrq3v6r0bvmu20a5o8ennm9da4vig_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs)
Tom Homan
IRLI Senior Fellow and former ICE Acting Director

P.S. If you want to restore the rule of law in the United States of America, [**I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible gift to IRLI today.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhl12ctrjfukpmhei35r18petgfh9rdeqr5o8qs0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slimao34cjh2bs)

P.P.S. Your gift will give our attorneys the resources they need in this crucial legal battle and force the Biden administration to start deporting the criminals they've released all over our country.

body:

Peter, Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We've seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don't let its banal name fool you -- it's a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it's not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.
**[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60930084:6uGtQ6VNL:m:1:3317145305:ED55DD2653ADD3492F11D018F39004E3:r "PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them.

And it's working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They're going woke. _**And the consequences are dire.**_

As Governor, I'm making sure we fight back. This isn't just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of **_**Left-wing activists who couldn 't run a lemonade stand.**_

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left's agenda. Now, in Florida, we've prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida's money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state's money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida's retirees. That's what the people of Florida deserve.
**[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60930084:6uGtQ6VNL:m:1:3317145305:ED55DD2653ADD3492F11D018F39004E3:r "AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
**But we didn 't stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left's favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That's right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don't like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**
* **Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.**
* **Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.**
* **Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.**

The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.**

_No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down._

**I hope you'll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us.** [I hope you'll be there with me to fight back.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60930084:6uGtQ6VNL:m:1:3317145305:ED55DD2653ADD3492F11D018F39004E3:r "I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.")

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don't let its banal name fool you -- it's a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it's not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders. "PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>" The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them. And it's working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They're going woke. And the consequences are dire. As Governor, I'm making sure we fight back. This isn't just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of Left-wing activists who couldn 't run a lemonade stand. We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left's agenda. Now, in Florida, we've prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida's money based on political factors. We want them to invest the state's money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida's retirees. That's what the people of Florida deserve. "AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>" But we didn 't stop there. We also took aim at one of the Left's favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That's right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don't like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods. That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism. These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today. The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position. I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob. Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years. Fighting the Fauci fanatics. Keeping kids in schools and businesses open. Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most. Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel. The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office. No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down. I hope you'll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us. name: Amy Loudenbeck for WI Secretary of State
subject: SIX DAYS until Wisconsin Primary Election!
body:
Make your plan to vote!
| | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend: We are officially SIX DAYS away from the Wisconsin Primary Election!
I'm writing today to remind you to make your plan to vote! And if you already have a plan, be sure to remind your family, friends and co-workers.
If you had an absentee ballot mailed to you - make sure to get in the mail ASAP so it arrives back to the clerk's office in time. Your ballot must be received on or before 8 pm on Election Day in order to be counted. You can also drop your ballot (and only your ballot) at your clerk's office as droboxes are not allowed.
In-person absentee voting is available until Friday - be sure to check with your local clerk's office to see if they offer walk-in office hours, or to make an appointment.
Primary Election Day is Tuesday, August 9th! Polls open at 7am and close at 8pm!
Since I announced I was running for Secretary of State in December of 2021, my team and I have traveled well over 25,000 miles and actively participated in opportunities to connect with voters in more than 45 counties in the great State of Wisconsin! In many other counties I have been honored to have my colleagues and friends serve as surrogates and share information. It has been an incredibly rewarding and humbling experience and for all of you who have helped me along the way - THANK YOU!
As I have said many times before - I won't be outworked by anyone in this election. As your Secretary of State I will bring that same work ethic to this Constitutional office that has been neglected for far too long and make it work again for the people.
As you make your plan to vote in the Primary Election next week, I hope you'll remember to vote for me. If you're willing, please tell your friends and family you're voting for me and encourage them to do the same.
Here's to winning the primary next week, and flipping this office for the first time in nearly 50 years!

Amy Loudenbeck

[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bd72253517bb4959b8b2180570e6c7ce&_e=YnZS4ZC_77iz6TvS2J450uSOP5eQgMPIFsCsupxPjVBHZXf4UDU8pny7tda9NVM5TxKKUT-u1p8HjKIiGg9Hv4H6A5nHmQAGITPDJFRxI_QuIE1dJIM_8A3RHKDE7cVArNyk7jtki0Euph7_dH987cunIzhHHX9kskTdR-YlbbOO7d2rRa7fsjniqFtMW2KhkLiLF3Q30oVZtQCT6OUvMT5uwNQTV3b4OOSZ2QNS3GcPT2dNjfewD2zRVkWQ4k2HlqiORt1DOKOTZm0H-gNSzlFeVvbYnoS-VX2xGrNqm84z6FdneChvbiRpyH1kCTH4zO-N3Qm8FBZ5VHteu5vDmI-3KHZ345Z63WlhFE1413Y%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Conservatives Give subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

body:
Our fight is not over - but yesterday told me what I already knew:
Peter -

I want to express my deepest gratitude to you and everyone on this team who showed up for Team Kilmer yesterday in the primary election.

I am honored and humbled by the support. The resources it takes to run a grassroots campaign like ours are tremendous. **But last night is a testament to each of you - who offered your time, sweat, and hard-earned dollars to help our effort**. To every person who made calls, put up signs, talked to their friends about what's at stake, and - most importantly - VOTED, I am forever grateful.

This is a defining moment for our country, and yesterday's primary was only the first step. Folks all across our region and our nation know what's at stake this November. The power of the ballot reaffirmed what I already knew: People want progress for our region - not political games or partisan extremism.

When reproductive freedom, the health of our environment, the right to marry the person we love - and so much more - were threatened, you showed up and stood up for a brighter future through the power of your vote. That's why I am hopeful about what the future holds - not just for our district but for our democracy

And on November 8th - we'll finish what we started, Peter. Together, we will help people in our region recover from the pandemic. We will stand up for reform and fight for accountability at all levels of government. And, we will get the government working again, for the people.

I'm enormously grateful for your support - and, as always, I'm proud to represent you.

Best,

Derek

clean_body: Our fight is not over - but yesterday told me what I already knew: Peter - I want to express my deepest gratitude to you and everyone on this team who showed up for Team Kilmer yesterday in the primary election. The power of the ballot reaffirmed what I already knew: People want progress for our region - not political games or partisan extremism. When reproductive freedom, the health of our environment, the right to marry the person we love - and so much more - were threatened, you showed up and stood up for a brighter future through the power of your vote. And, we will get the government working again, for the people. I'm enormously grateful for your support - and, as always, I'm proud to represent you. | This is shameful.

I’m talking about the **Senate Republicans who voted against a bill to provide healthcare to veterans exposed to toxic chemicals** (aka the PACT Act).

And what’s just as shameful – for our country and for our Texan veterans – is that Ronny Jackson, who claims to be a champion for veterans, is...silent.

**In fact, Ronny Jackson[voted against the PACT Act](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=13067244f0&e=4712f71bea) when it was heard in the House just a few months ago.**

Texas’ own representative voting against veterans...this is just disgraceful.

_Our veterans are the backbone of this country_ , and deserve to be treated with the utmost respect and dignity.

By voting against the PACT Act and remaining silent about veteran rights, Ronny Jackson has disrespected those who have made the ultimate sacrifice.

[**If you are ready for new leadership who will honor our veterans, I hope that you will support my campaign today.**](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=40e5b80366&e=4712f71bea)****

subject: How do we mend a divided Nation?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
How do we bridge the political divide? How do we build trust, honesty, and collaboration?
Social capital! Get to know others. Socialize. Reach out. Listen and respect each other.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
HELP ME REPLACE BERGMAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
How do we break the deadlock in Washington? It starts at home. It starts with us, and then it has to trickle up to the ballot box!
Start engaging with your neighbors. We can find common ground, and we can do it any way you wish...
*
Neighborhood
friendships
*
Dinner
parties
*
Group
discussions
*
Club
memberships
*
Church
*
Sports
*
Charities
*
At
work
We are more alike than different.
However, we may have different methods of reaching our goals to protect and enrich our lives and that of our family and friends.
Once we understand each other, we can build trust and faith with reciprocity. When this happens, we can civilly debate and discuss policies to reach our mutual goals together.
I promise to do this in Congress. I will reach out to understand and learn from my colleagues across the aisle and invite them to see things from our perspective. Yes, some members of Congress are unreasonable , but with most, to get things done - we must learn to trust and respect each other.
We will move forward together. This is the work of being your Representative.
Congratulations to all the candidates moving forward with us to the General Election, and a huge thank you to all those who ran honorable primary campaigns.
We advance with the most votes of any Democratic primary candidate in the history of Michigan’s First District.
I am very grateful for everyone's support. Thank you. We have a lot of work to do over the next three months, but with you in my corner we will multiply turnout and make history again in November.
We now have less than 100 days to election day. Can you please make a contribution today to our General Election fund?

body:
We came up with a lil quiz.
#
Derek,
There’s a lot wrong with John’s opponent Dr. Oz... So much, in fact, that it’s hard for even *us* to keep track of sometimes.
**So we came up with a lil quiz to help folks really get to know Dr. Oz. Test your knowledge starting with Question #1 below.**
[How long has Dr. Oz lived in PA, the state where he’s running for U.S. Senate? ](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/dr-oz-quiz/?source=em20220803-6735&t=1&akid=6735%2E434096%2EY1HaC-)
Select your answer: Born + raised, just like John 50 years 25 years 5 years at least? He literally just “moved” here to run for U.S. Senate (but still lives in his NJ mega-mansion)

For example, you might know something about Dr. Oz’s time on TV, making a fortune selling quack medicine.
But did you know just how extreme his views are on abortion? Did you know how rich he actually is?
[**_Take our new quiz to test your knowledge of Dr. Oz. You might be shocked!_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/dr-oz-quiz/?source=em20220803-6735&t=3&akid=6735%2E434096%2EY1HaC-)__

clean_body: | | Friend, Today, we’re thrilled to endorse the re-election of Rep. Susan Wild (PA-07), Rep. Matt Cartwright (PA-08), as well as the election of State Rep. Summer Lee (PA-12), and Chris Deluzio (PA-17). These leaders have proven progressive records and have fought tirelessly for a better future for younger generations. Together, this slate of progressive candidates in Pennsylvania has earned our votes. They represent the values of young people in Pennsylvania, and we can count on them to listen to the largest and most diverse generation in American history. Rep. Susan Wild has fought for voting rights, safeguarded abortion care, and committed to expanding access to education — she’ll continue this fight upon re-election. Rep. Matt Cartwright firmly believes protecting our clean air and water and creating jobs go hand-in-hand. By re-electing him, he’ll be able to continue his work to invest in Pennsylvania schools and increase the federal minimum wage. State Rep. Summer Lee has made it clear that if elected, she will prioritize expanding abortion access and LGBTQIA+ rights. She’s also a fierce advocate for environmental and immigrant justice, which disproportionately affects Black and Brown communities. Chris Deluzio has focused on voting rights, election security, labor, as well as the intersection of technology and civil rights. Defeating the far-right MAGA Republicans who are running against our endorsed candidates will be no simple task, but we've seen what’s possible when we turn out and vote. Our generation has the power to determine the future of Pennsylvania. name: Maxwell Frost
subject: defying the odds
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| A victim of the system and enmeshed in trying circumstances, my biological mother turned to drugs and crime while she was pregnant with me.

She didn’t have healthcare during this time and wasn’t able to see a doctor even once.

As the mother of seven, she made the difficult decision to put me up for adoption because she lacked the resources to care and raise another child.

I learned all of this just two months before I announced my run for Congress.

**Understanding my biological mother’s story and the circumstances surrounding my birth underscored for me why politics is so important. And it further crystallized my core vision of it - that we need our elected leaders who view the world through the eyes of the most vulnerable.**

My community needs a leader like that in Congress and I’m running to be that person - someone that fights every day for and with the marginalized and disadvantaged. A champion for working people.

This isn’t new for me though. I’ve been fighting for my community since I was 15 years old when I became an advocate for ending gun violence following the Sandy Hook shooting.

After the death of George Floyd, I became one of the lead Black Lives Matters organizers in Orlando, where I went out every day to fight for justice and Black lives. I was beaten by cops, tear-gassed, and jailed for those efforts.

In 2018, I helped lead the ACLU of Florida’s fight to win Amendment 4, which restored voting rights to over 1.6 million Floridians who had previous felony convictions.

While at the ACLU in 2020, I worked to win Biden’s support for abolishing the Hyde Amendment, legislation that has limited abortion access for millions of people.

As Organizing Director at March for Our Lives, one of the largest youth political movements in the country, I led an ambitious voter turnout program that helped drive a record number of young people to the polls, helping to hold the House, and win a Democratic Senate, and Presidency.

**I share all of this with you, so you understand the kind of leader I am and will be.** [I didn’t make it this far on my own and I’m going to need your support to continue my fight in Congress. I need to raise another $3,752 to hit my midnight goal in 10 hours. Please, if you can, split $7 right now between my campaign and VPP »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20637?t=7&akid=3960%2E878179%2ELOIWzC) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Maxwell Frost and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20643?t=13&akid=3960%2E878179%2ELOIWzC)

[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20644?t=14&akid=3960%2E878179%2ELOIWzC)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20645?t=15&akid=3960%2E878179%2ELOIWzC)
I wouldn’t be asking for your help if there wasn’t so much at stake.

**Our society is structured in a way that makes life more difficult for the most vulnerable among us._A system that makes it nearly impossible to earn a living wage, obtain access to healthcare, and escape gun violence._**

And right now, they’re raking in millions in GOP dark money to maintain power and shut out anyone who tries to challenge their destructive policies.

I’m ready to fight back in Congress, but if my campaign doesn’t have the funds to get me there, our voices will continue to be silenced. We can’t let that happen.
[Your help can make all the difference. I’m counting on grassroots donors to get me to the finish line. Can you split just $7 between my campaign and VPP before my critical midnight deadline?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20637?t=17&akid=3960%2E878179%2ELOIWzC)

body:
Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z01c1gfnuphetmq6god8odom8ujd75pikg6768qo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim1or4cph238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onh6jhbeotgmsp68p3ledqbac75mtgmeclhc9irdd74c1in4sdmcli6acplm9rjfduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74cb6e6qbbd37m9omcc3gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znaitv2qan2e8h386tb14irq7qq9f67n3a4o85eo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim1or4cph2bs)
---
Friend, Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We’ve seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don’t let its banal name fool you — it’s a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it’s not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.
**[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8nbqs51ve2vfje6n5lqggve6pd8mf3i3pas7s6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim1or4cph2bs "PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE")**
The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them.

And it’s working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They’re going woke. _**And the consequences are dire.**_

As Governor, I’m making sure we fight back. This isn’t just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of **_**Left-wing activists who couldn’t run a lemonade stand.**_

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left’s agenda. Now, in Florida, we’ve prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida’s money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state’s money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida’s retirees. That’s what the people of Florida deserve.
**[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z95j10gm2olca3lpmhbeft69rtjkli7au42b4ddo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim1or4cph2bs "AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE")**
**But we didn’t stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left’s favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That’s right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don’t like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don’t agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That’s not happening in Florida. I’m not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn’t stopped the Left from attacking me. That’s why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they’ve gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we’re doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes – successes that look like common sense to average Americans – as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That’s why I need your help. That’s why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**
* **Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.**
* **Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.**
* **Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.**

The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.**

_No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down._

** I hope you’ll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us.** [I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9a03fg5ac5f05c3ri9mii00jl89nlnfmvu2k508_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slim1or4cph2bs "I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.")

**Sincerely, __

| | _Thank you, Peter._

**Over the past 15 months, we have built a truly unprecedented grassroots campaign** \- inspiring and mobilizing __hundreds of thousands of Michiganders__ to stand up and fight for our beloved state, our freedoms, and the sacred values we share as Americans.

_Last night's results were not what we were hoping for. _But I will sleep soundly knowing that our phenomenal volunteer team, our tireless campaign staff, our grassroots warriors and movement members **left it all on the field.**

>From Day One, this campaign has been of the people, by the people, for the people. **We did things our way, and we never backed down. **

We’re using this final week to speak to Vermonters directly, and we’re counting on this grassroots coalition to help power this late push.

Hi there,
It’s Miles, reaching out on behalf of the Peter Welch for Senate campaign.
We’ve officially got less than a week until the primary, and that means we’re hitting the ground hard over the next few days to get as many voters to the polls as possible.
We’ve grown this movement through our digital efforts on social media and in emails, but Peter’s fate in this election will ultimately be up to the people of Vermont. This primary is sure to inform our efforts for the fall, so we’re using this final week to pound the pavement and speak to Vermonters directly, and we’re counting on this grassroots coalition to help power one last push. With the Senate majority on the line, we’re taking nothing for granted.
[**We’ve got some ambitious goals, but together, we’ll exceed them and get Peter one step closer to the Senate. Can you help this team reach as many voters as possible before Tuesday?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3661?t=3&akid=750%2E61531%2EeqvnPY)

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Mat
[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838fc55007634e499cbca2d3d48bb5dc&_e=YfIf9OETQdlYtTxolwwb7qymQaDw6jpkF7eiGZfhbiExSwVeW7CcBx_n541yuqqX45DFpx0IJt0W2eb0IvFylUjsnODUumqs1Uaanm2NjYUKD-jyCgyyfxc9FqUUnPPjIztBCFh6-UZ03_jMA-6wQg5HDllb7VmiX4VLGxp-BQL-KMimRnhNmsjwU2NM_w4iGZzwD4Hevrogyrt9Z-6mKN0HtdDuvQQVL9-WALrKco0gjs1lpCVzegeqIyS-7rcodGT2W1-T3BGwdVXnfPP1tWL112dBoDlNC6h9MC9EXNwj0_WGEvDou_oOztmaiShDm717BMW2OSSdqP3ZTJHNDXKHh6_KwRIXNZwYKSXSSWM%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838fc55007634e499cbca2d3d48bb5dc&_e=YfIf9OETQdlYtTxolwwb7qymQaDw6jpkF7eiGZfhbiExSwVeW7CcBx_n541yuqqX45DFpx0IJt0W2eb0IvFylUjsnODUumqs1Uaanm2NjYUKD-jyCgyyfxc9FqUUnPPjIztBCFh6-UZ03_jMA-6wQjcqYEttPUEf8eWtPpQYMzyNbdulRlpyMbRuuwtBk_IVeEZe3xlXk_LBaFjK5rA91wvp2dudZfThdKucjQyOUpvrxRhqDr-6XcvQgOSrxcNE5AJ8DOoOxW7NaRog03Tw6BHmfSeAUw7kjrchoXqAy6lZz7hRnVGUuk2JDCik7BjtcEA7gKLIJeWbsozb_4_3pveDJpn1j5igXRKd4xG_z3M%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838fc55007634e499cbca2d3d48bb5dc&_e=YfIf9OETQdlYtTxolwwb7qymQaDw6jpkF7eiGZfhbiExSwVeW7CcBx_n541yuqqX45DFpx0IJt0W2eb0IvFylUjsnODUumqs1Uaanm2NjYUKD-jyCgyyfxc9FqUUnPPjIztBCFh6-UZ03_jMA-6wQqSrZX5gdV6ExkGGnjPmC7df_LPhkmarukZ87KT7tZkoLdNTabYJw2PgaS7YpOtySAxMlOp0P6E1Qb238fQWeTqAq-ytfHNRUzszwQk8nx52m-J097GXs_qu41Mpl1goNIAclr1h1w9j74mNJFJbntbaGq4Wy0fhIeSVepToodprK75YHFnBy1kU3iiIm2SBf9-F31hW5vdk7laWVfFhCOU%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

If we lose just one seat, Mitch McConnell regains Senate control
| | |
---
I have 15 minutes of free time this morning, friend. It may not sound like much – but I've been working long hours in Congress to pass President Biden's agenda, and a gap in my schedule like this is rare.
So, as I'm sitting with my husband, Jerry, and drinking my coffee, I'm reflecting on this historic campaign – and I've decided I need to tell you a little bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate.
Back when I was growing up in Jacksonville, I went to segregated schools, washed dishes and worked at McDonald's. But my mom saw something special in me. She'd tell me I was _destined_ for something bigger.
So, when I thought about 2022 and what our country needed to build back better after a disastrous presidency, I thought about her everlasting words to me: "Never tire, Val." I thought about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader who understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I thought about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy. And, in the background of all of this, I heard my mother's voice in my head telling me I could win.
So, I decided to run. And now, I'm a few points from Marco Rubio in a race that can decide Senate control, and the stakes are higher than ever: We have a 50-50 split in the Senate. If we lose just one seat, Mitch McConnell regains Senate control – and three Democratic seats are already rated toss-ups.

It's critical that we win in Florida – and this race is tight right now, friend. I'm proud that our movement has an average donation of just $28.45, but building a people-powered movement means it's going to take all hands on deck to compete against the GOP's millions in dark money already pouring into Florida.
My 15 minutes are almost up, and I have to run to my next call: I hate to ask this, but if you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $5 today?
