subject: I’m tired of republicans who bow to Pelosi
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1b0384fqv4r6fqub02derp53t9scq2m5cav30fo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onge5in2dr6e4q3fdb3m4p69pbksuqn9dblmko66ohlclo76o30egq67c33mdpj1puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmkq3fcjgcooreddm6uobapbi4no)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z93usane0jrpaii4rebg36trlq1ocms4ovnovj20_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zidns1lqskgarhcreb0rp0nuhvacfm4osnas5sog_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z89ssmj76uj9tou6qulirbq3hnsplrff45lnmp0g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztv8gv360o5voef37hqvvfd8v5jbjhvfeiteeh58_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9f7944mvf06vjutbn0sc8rs9ujnsspcs1lneui8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm6o3puril6a173hrah7schtijttgka7m0hjjmlo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv43nicd76k9gsppuiufdtk06pgoil7cfllv6uuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

[DONATE](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zugdip8knfa6r057f6bno23bmpfpfocinqes2r4o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm0pb1cph2bs)

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: Together, we can flip Missouri blue
body:
It's official, Derek:
I am the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Missouri, and I'll be facing off against Eric Schmitt.
The stakes have never been higher. If you send me to the Senate, I will be the 51st vote we need to pass truly comprehensive gun reform, protect the right to an abortion, and break through the partisan divide.
And I know we can win. Our momentum is building like never before, but our opponent, Eric Schmitt, will be mobilizing powerful forces to defeat us. I need you with me in this fight, Derek.
Please, can you split a donation between me and CommonGood to power this campaign all the way to November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_busch?refcode=20220803_CGVA_TBV]
Folks know that it's time for something different. And they know I'll lead with compassion and prioritize people, not partisanship. As a nurse, I'll listen to you and your concerns, not to the lobbyists. A nurse has never been elected to the Senate, but Washington sure could use the honesty, integrity, and problem-solving skills that nurses like me exemplify.
We're taking this campaign all the way to Washington – and we've got a long road ahead of us. Our opponent has deep-pocketed allies who will do anything to keep this Senate seat red.
But we have something even more powerful: you . By donating even just $1, you're powering our campaign forward and making an investment to end the opioid crisis, make daily life more affordable, and bring kindness and compassion to Washington.
We have a big fight ahead of us, and I can't take on Eric Schmitt without you on my team. I need your support today and every step of the way to Election Day. So please, can you split a donation between me and CommonGood – whatever you can spare will help – to flip this seat blue and send a leader with a nurse's heart and mind to Washington? disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gashi for Congress
body:
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 3, 2022
Contact: Yuridia Peña, yuridia@altaconsulting.co, (718) 790-0837

**FORMER CONGRESSWOMAN NITA M. LOWEY ENDORSES VEDAT GASHI FOR CONGRESS**

**RYE, NEW YORK** - Today, former Congresswoman Nita M. Lowey endorsed Vedat Gashi for Congress in New York's 16th district and issued the following statement:
"Over the course of my 32 years in Congress, I represented nearly all of the communities now included in the 16th CD. As Chair of the House Appropriations Committee, I focused on national, international and local issues of importance to my Westchester constituents."
"Today, I announce my enthusiastic support of Vedat Gashi for Congress. Vedat is young, smart, experienced, and hard working. He shares my values and priorities. If elected, he will be a worthy successor."
###
**_About Vedat Gashi:_**
Vedat Gashi is a current Westchester County legislator who came to the U.S. as a refugee when his parents fled an oppressive regime in Kosovo. Raised in the Bronx and now raising his own family in Yorktown, Vedat has experienced the promise and hard realities of the American Dream. He knows what it's like to grow up without food on the table, which is why he is focused on getting real results for us on our everyday priorities. And as a refugee from a country without democracy, it pains Vedat to see our leaders and Democrats fighting each other instead of working together to get things done. As a county legislator, Vedat has always delivered and worked with others to get results - putting people and the everyday issues, not partisan politics, first. As the Chair of Appropriations, Vedat has built support for expanding services while cutting taxes, and in Congress, he will do the same. Vedat is focused on making real progress on the kitchen table issues like holding down taxes, lowering health care costs, strengthening our infrastructure, and improving our economy. Visit [gashiforcongress.com](https://act.myngp.com/el/Yb93apgP2sn_ZdgXyhWuPFGeY7CTSlhZkMq9Uc_zC-g=/00dRz5gLB4D5-EcL5dgIjDnz2BjKBebw7C87N8EW9h4=) for more information.

* * *

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvt8m6h2q1dpgn0os2iq3a4lqa2goku9guirrhdg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm4oj2cph2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztj16p27b7am6dr32knpidbv8a1s3dqb15sq1nn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4slhm4oj2cph2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe

body:
Despite major obstacles thrown their way, Reps. Rashida Tlaib and Cori Bush won their primaries.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220803-3270-header&t=1&akid=3270%2E2526796%2EFLCznT)
We’ll start with the good news.
Despite major spending by dark money groups, Reps. Rashida Tlaib and Cori Bush _**won**_ their primaries last night.
They won despite major obstacles thrown their way. A new special interest group spent nearly $700,000 backing Rashida’s opponent,1 while Cori faced Republican dark money groups who spent tens of thousands of dollars in radio ads in the final weeks before the primary.2
These victories mark a huge win for our movement in an election year that has seen progressives embattled by outside spending and little support — and sometimes outright opposition — by the party establishment.
**And they were only possible because of people like you who chipped in so that their teams had the resources to talk one-on-one to voters, run ads, print lawn signs, send voter-contact texts, and so much more.**
[We must be prepared to fend off these dark money attacks and ensure that we send progressive incumbents like Alexandria back to Congress in November. If you’re able to, can you chip in whatever you can right now to help us prepare for November? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220803.vENlkG&refcode=em20220803-3270-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3270%2E2526796%2EFLCznT)

These coordinated attacks on our campaigns are only growing. We don’t take money from corporate PACs or special interests. Instead we rely on grassroots, small-dollar donations from emails like this.
[Any support, even $5 or $10 goes a long way. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220803.vENlkG&refcode=em20220803-3270-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3270%2E2526796%2EFLCznT)
Thank you for your support and congratulations again to Cori and Rashida on their much-deserved wins.
In solidarity,

For the first time in Georgia's history, both Democrats and Republicans have nominated a Black man for the U.S. Senate.

**That may be where the similarities end.**

In the past, he said:

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_

and
_**"I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_

---

**Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it.**

name: Herschel Walker
subject: The “N” word
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---
Peter,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **" ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **" a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**" tokens"**_ who are _**" shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**" Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

_**Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing.**_

The loudest and clearest way to push back against these kinds of disgusting attacks is to defeat them at the ballot box. **[Please help me stand up against MSNBC, reject racist commentators, and defeat silent Democrats by donating $25, $35, $50, or even $100 right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60930027:6mMj66VNo:m:1:3253819041:219023259F771A988242C4165FE259AA:r)**

Enough is enough. It's time to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[I hope we can count on your support at this time.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60930027:6mMj66VNo:m:1:3253819041:219023259F771A988242C4165FE259AA:r)**

Thanks,

Herschel Walker

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7c76dc739364e2695dc4c99467119c4&_e=TOrP31qdAt6FM7Y7umlXrDEzC9_wB2KyLYxiXKaDWeAHtd4GvOtaDTvkeztjHjVTZkia0XGHysvM9UBDcE-uiS-KQHydY3A3xTev_MFpB45Q4q0t27bmTc6pT33580hfPlL9nZsrhDVb3q3qyCxfkY-5-stfV-cZY7Ukot11f-tciFWXd32d8S0vCGWm-rMLP76mcPBt8vyeMk23rO81xtmBcD_QJSAWz6ndPwrf7mdUwyHldsOlYzMyJM5sG8inRT9eQoEGYjVLkiNj-Xyw4sFF9l-a3zfex3HxPnshlaVvS_rK9Vk4KeSLM3apzXtG2MioSy7LsFHvnrdB6ifC-FYGpKzYW4HtH1nip-uUqf8%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7c76dc739364e2695dc4c99467119c4&_e=TOrP31qdAt6FM7Y7umlXrDEzC9_wB2KyLYxiXKaDWeAHtd4GvOtaDTvkeztjHjVTZkia0XGHysvM9UBDcE-uiS-KQHydY3A3xTev_MFpB45Q4q0t27bmTc6pT33580hfPlL9nZsrhDVb3q3qyCxfkdaaQ4FCauzhvkF-qRjsvQIz9ltLAvBS28C8uJHfJKlolDxrzwSp3PL_TnIpgWccpfRG018tZA1nJJCXgdnQeqJW0NUbJHThyk0N38wq49bluERG0iKXa7zECSjZjgHNw1zi8SK5SV3Wp9RnJjTgm1NQ6cir9m3ksbuparHjKYtB9uKadEv8cN4VOJ5vdVBcayRblNS5peZ9wUV7Fmi_mP4%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

body:
| Both inflation and climate change are issues that no matter who you are, or where you come from, they can majorly affect your life.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=604%2E5257348%2EqemZGV)
Derek,
Late last week, Senators Joe Manchin and Chuck Schumer finally came to an agreement on landmark legislation to make major investments to fight climate change, combat inflation, and lower the cost of prescription drugs.
I can’t tell you how big this is. Is it everything we want? No. But could it be the biggest investment in our nation’s history to fight climate change and create green jobs? Oh, you betcha. And after this, we’ll have more work to do.
But listen, we need to get this legislation through the House and Senate and to President Biden’s desk for his signature. ASAP.
[**Add your name to join my call for the Senate to pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ this week, before the Senate’s August recess.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20220803-ira-petition.cFj9Qw&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220803_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=604%2E5257348%2EqemZGV)
[SIGN ON](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20220803-ira-petition.cFj9Qw&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220803_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=604%2E5257348%2EqemZGV)
---
Right now, we’re experiencing record-breaking hot temperatures due to global warming and rising costs due to Putin’s war of aggression in Ukraine and the pandemic’s continued effects on global supply chains.
But this is the legislation that the American people, and indeed the world, have been waiting for — to show that the United States is once again leading the effort to save the planet. You donated. Knocked on doors. Made phone calls. Sent texts. Drove friends and family to the polls — or helped them fill out their absentee ballots at kitchen tables.
To confront climate change. To take on Big Pharma and lower drug costs. And to make all big corporations finally pay their fair share — with a corporate minimum tax, costs on fossil fuel emissions, and no tax increases for small businesses or anyone earning less than $400,000.
I’m determined to push for this legislation, and _much more_ , so that working families across the country can live without worrying about inflating prices or what planet they’ll be leaving behind for their kids.
The _Inflation Reduction Act_ would invest **$370 billion** in clean energy, cap prescription drug prices, and institute a corporate minimum tax.
So let’s go. Working families can’t wait any longer. _Our environment can’t wait any longer._ And I think we all fear if we wait any longer, this deal might get scuttled.
[**Add your name to join me in urging Senate Democrats to pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ through reconciliation before the end of this week and the start of the August recess.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20220803-ira-petition.cFj9Qw&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220803_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=604%2E5257348%2EqemZGV)
[SIGN ON](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20220803-ira-petition.cFj9Qw&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220803_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=604%2E5257348%2EqemZGV)
---
This is exciting news — now let’s see it through to the end.
Thank you for stepping up to speak out about this crucial legislation.
— Adam

I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, I watched my parents live the American Dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748958/359430895/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
At a young age, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748959/359430896/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I set out to make it happen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748960/359430897/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
As a young woman, I fulfilled my dream of becoming a nurse. Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748961/359430898/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
During my time working in a hospital, I saw the importance of quality healthcare firsthand. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that everyone should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748962/359430899/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need a nurse's heart in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748963/359430900/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)
If I could go back and talk to any of the younger versions of me in these photos, she wouldn't believe it if I told her we would one day be on the cusp of taking our heart of service all the way to the U.S. Senate. **I hope I am making her,****my family****, and – most importantly – you proud.**
Running a campaign with stakes this high is scary, for sure. Still, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't excited for November. **I know that on Election Day, we're going to prove to everyone that hope, compassion, and people-first politics _can_ win. **But I need your help to do that, and right now, we're falling $3,482 short of our next midnight grassroots fundraising goal.
**I'd really hate to miss a critical goal like this one so soon after our primary victory, so I have to ask you: **[Please, can you make a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare tonight, to power this campaign to November and help me bring compassion, honesty, and respect back to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48748964/359430901/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk206-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWU1M2Q1OC03ODEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6shr194I2d361iMU8LrZb-F5GQFp-vlP9qVHel8v7-U=)

Wade_ , access to this medical care is already being denied in red states across the country. Republicans in Texas are literally suing for the right to let women die in emergency rooms. ---
Some outstanding news came out of the Sunflower State last night. An amendment was on the ballot with the intention to remove the right to an abortion from the Kansas state constittution — clearing the way for extreme abortion bans. The ultimate question voters were answering was: _“Do you want the right to an abortion to be removed from the state constitution?” _**Kansans turned out and sent a strong message: No. No. NO.** I’m so grateful for every organizer, voter, and supporter who helped stop this dangerous ballot measure in its tracks. **And I’m so grateful for everyone on this team who made a donation when we put out a call to support Kansans for Constitutional Freedom — the outstanding organization at the center of this fight — after the Supreme Court decision. It mattered. You all helped make the difference.** This was the first time abortion rights were on the ballot at the state level since Roe v. Wade was overturned — and last night showed that voters simply do not want abortion bans. And when we organize and fight for abortion protections at the state level, we can win. The right-wing extremists who plotted to overturn Roe had no idea of the level of anger — and determination — they’d unleash. Our momentum is only growing stronger, and we have more chances ahead to mobilize voters, make our voices heard, and fight back against these extreme anti-abortion efforts. One important opportunity that we have ahead of us: If we can expand our Democratic majority in the Senate _by just two seats_ , and if we hold onto the House, we will be able to protect the right to an abortion nationwide through federal law. In Wisconsin and Pennsylvania — two states that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won in 2020 — Mandela Barnes and John Fetterman are running strong campaigns to flip Republican-held Senate seats. They both support ending the filibuster to pass legislation that would ensure abortion rights nationwide. Flipping these two seats is in our reach, and that’s well worth fighting for today. [_**So if you’re able, can you split a donation of $3 or whatever makes sense between Mandela Barnes, John Fetterman, and Warren Democrats right now to strengthen our mobilization efforts for protecting abortion rights across the country? Every contribution adds up to build a groundswell of grassroots support and win this fight.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48749375/359432493/-941849412?refcode=EMZ7A_ROE_20220803_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Y2QyZmM1Ny03YTEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=047MP6ycX-BYRTNxPHbrIh_7ns7aodQAjVKsUIaj7PA=) | _If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

clean_body: Right-wing extremists who plotted to overturn Roe had no idea of the level of anger they’d unleash. | | | Some outstanding news came out of the Sunflower State last night. An amendment was on the ballot with the intention to remove the right to an abortion from the Kansas state constittution — clearing the way for extreme abortion bans. The ultimate question voters were answering was: “Do you want the right to an abortion to be removed from the state constitution?” Kansans turned out and sent a strong message: No. No. NO. I’m so grateful for every organizer, voter, and supporter who helped stop this dangerous ballot measure in its tracks. And I’m so grateful for everyone on this team who made a donation when we put out a call to support Kansans for Constitutional Freedom — the outstanding organization at the center of this fight — after the Supreme Court decision. It mattered. You all helped make the difference. This was the first time abortion rights were on the ballot at the state level since Roe v. Wade was overturned — and last night showed that voters simply do not want abortion bans. And when we organize and fight for abortion protections at the state level, we can win. The right-wing extremists who plotted to overturn Roe had no idea of the level of anger — and determination — they’d unleash. Our momentum is only growing stronger, and we have more chances ahead to mobilize voters, make our voices heard, and fight back against these extreme anti-abortion efforts. One important opportunity that we have ahead of us: If we can expand our Democratic majority in the Senate by just two seats , and if we hold onto the House, we will be able to protect the right to an abortion nationwide through federal law. In Wisconsin and Pennsylvania — two states that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won in 2020 — Mandela Barnes and John Fetterman are running strong campaigns to flip Republican-held Senate seats. They both support ending the filibuster to pass legislation that would ensure abortion rights nationwide. name: Charles Booker
subject: Everything just changed.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, last night,
the people of Kansas delivered a victory for reproductive rights.

In a statewide referendum, a coalition of Democrats, Independents, and
even 20% of Republicans voted to reject a ballot measure that would remove
the right to abortion from the State Constitution.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220803.ov9an_&refcode=em20220803-2310&t=1001&akid=2310%2E346206%2ERiyhgH ][IMG]

Peter, the
people of Kansas spoke last night: the government does not have the right
to mandate pregnancy.

But here is the thing. What happened in Kansas is just the beginning of
what’s to come. The GOP unleashed a lion when they struck down Roe. It
roared in Kansas last night, and Kentucky is next.

Until two days ago, abortion was legal in Kentucky until an Appeals Court
sided with our extremist Attorney General and reinstated an effective ban.
But like Kansas, Kentucky has its own amendment on the ballot in November,
and the people of Kentucky are fired up to defeat it.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220803.ov9an_&refcode=em20220803-2310&t=1002&akid=2310%2E346206%2ERiyhgH ]Peter, when
Kentuckians go to the ballot box this November, we’re going to vote to
protect reproductive rights and retire Rand Paul, who wants a nationwide
ban on abortion. Will you donate today to help us get there?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220803.ov9an_&refcode=em20220803-2310&t=1021&akid=2310%2E346206%2ERiyhgH ]Contribute $5

What happened in Kansas changes everything in this race. Pro-choice voters
are more motivated than ever to show up to the polls in November, and we
know that when more people vote, we win. We also know that a significant
number of Republican voters are fed up with the GOP’s dangerous agenda to
strip bodily autonomy from women.

Let me be clear about what this means. This is exactly the coalition of
voters we need to show up in November in Kentucky to reject Amendment 2
and send me to the United States Senate to codify Roe. We will win.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220803.ov9an_&refcode=em20220803-2310&t=1022&akid=2310%2E346206%2ERiyhgH ]Chip in to help me defeat Rand this November, and I will be the 51st
vote to codify Roe v. Wade.

Let’s do this,
Peter.

Charles Booker

| | Freedom Fighters,

We passed landmark election integrity legislation to ban private dollars like “Zuck bucks” from funding our elections, the State Senate audited Maricopa County’s 2020 results, and uncovered vulnerability after vulnerability the Left has used to manipulate election procedures. And though my campaign ends today, the fight for the future of Arizona continues.

Thank you once again for your unwavering support,

If you’ve seen the news already, you saw that I did not prevail in this race. We ran a solid campaign, but the voters of Arizona have made their voice heard. From day one, I’ve fought to restore election integrity. body:
Read about the bill and our statement. | Hey y’all, **** Just as Crystal and Jason were entering into a multi-day ceremony halfway across the country, we learned of the disheartening news affecting MVP, and nationwide pipeline resistance efforts... **** A surprise side deal struck between Conservative Democratic West Virginia Sen. Joe Manchin and the Democratic Party Leadership in Washington could mean fast-tracking MVP to completion, and have grave impacts on pipeline resistance nationally, if their proposed permitting reform bill passes in September. Check out our statement below, and the articles we’ve found helpful to wrap our heads around this. _**We are grateful to be standing with you, and we shall not be moved.**_
---
|
---
# 7 Directions Statement on Permitting Reform Proposal
---
In order to win Conservative Democratic West Virginia Sen. Joe Manchin’s support for the Inflation Reduction Act–a climate and tax package–Democratic Leadership struck a surprise side deal with Manchin that could force the completion of the Mountain Valley Pipeline. In exchange for Manchin’s vote, Party Leaders promised to pass a law (currently being referred to as a permitting reform bill) that would require relevant agencies “to take all necessary actions to permit the construction and operation of the Mountain Valley Pipeline and give the DC Circuit jurisdiction over any further litigation.” This permitting reform bill (which will proceed as its own legislation, apart from the Inflation Reduction Act) would overhaul the approval and permitting processes for energy projects in a way that benefits pipeline corporations and the fossil fuel industry into the future. clean_body: Read about the bill and our statement. | Hey y’all, ** Just as Crystal and Jason were entering into a multi-day ceremony halfway across the country, we learned of the disheartening news affecting MVP, and nationwide pipeline resistance efforts... A surprise side deal struck between Conservative Democratic West Virginia Sen. Joe Manchin and the Democratic Party Leadership in Washington could mean fast-tracking MVP to completion, and have grave impacts on pipeline resistance nationally, if their proposed permitting reform bill passes in September. Check out our statement below, and the articles we’ve found helpful to wrap our heads around this. We are grateful to be standing with you, and we shall not be moved. | 7 Directions Statement on Permitting Reform Proposal In order to win Conservative Democratic West Virginia Sen. Joe Manchin’s support for the Inflation Reduction Act–a climate and tax package–Democratic Leadership struck a surprise side deal with Manchin that could force the completion of the Mountain Valley Pipeline. In exchange for Manchin’s vote, Party Leaders promised to pass a law (currently being referred to as a permitting reform bill) that would require relevant agencies “to take all necessary actions to permit the construction and operation of the Mountain Valley Pipeline and give the DC Circuit jurisdiction over any further litigation.” This permitting reform bill (which will proceed as its own legislation, apart from the Inflation Reduction Act) would overhaul the approval and permitting processes for energy projects in a way that benefits pipeline corporations and the fossil fuel industry into the future. | Helpful articles: Get ready to take action: We’re still waiting for the official permitting reform bill to be released, and as soon as it is, we’ll need to stand together and oppose it, loud and clear. subject: 92 Degrees, 92 Calls!
body:
Hello!

Xan here, deputy field director for Carlina's campaign.

With only **_ten days left_** until voting begins, we really need all the help we can get so that we finish strong and send Carlina to congress.

Tomorrow in two shifts (4:00-6:00pm and 6:00-8:00pm) we'll be coming together on Zoom and calling voters throughout the district. On a day as hot as tomorrow (92 degrees!), most people will be home with the AC on, so it's a perfect time to call.

Again, there are only **_ten days left_** until voting begins so we appreciate any time you're able to give.

Thank you for your support!

Xan

\--

Xan Aird
Deputy Field Director
617.794.9398

Peter, Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We’ve seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don’t let its banal name fool you — it’s a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it’s not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.
**[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=19bc6d869afe40c181459621c06b9057&_e=44UMpjbVgw1qk95lJ3OGW3VkHjiDTy8mJqkmHmNNiuiBjs9b0faCvQz994ewj0B-zCdQtrEC2KaB3KZCOUbEv8Iz1y90ss6qhW2cm6x4Y8GBjFYDuL0I_58KdVeluFhY5JC2eFib5NCo1JcXyVxPIllHkDo-FCKB9uiKsttUS7PwxGamIP245y8_PZg9DvIvM3D7R9PRtBdO1xY97bvuJyy8wuY0TDglFkcRmOEuPqvvUAMC5wpGAC7cXfU4NnarA0BsUa779Cr27rWtF-moz37Cy4XBCT_dm1qJvLDtPArwi2P865-OHY3ZDfhVMjsSt25trttOhTyt7Fopu4JyQHaqnJD3uK7GL-b4mVLU85l1tR0Gjqc8FF3euABYA61TQsCRNfOpDRdDVgiF8ZZsSyadVIcalZ-A_cRTXbdHrr0%3D "PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them.

And it’s working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They’re going woke. _**And the consequences are dire.**_

As Governor, I’m making sure we fight back. This isn’t just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of **_**Left-wing activists who couldn’t run a lemonade stand.**_

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left’s agenda. Now, in Florida, we’ve prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida’s money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state’s money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida’s retirees. That’s what the people of Florida deserve.
**[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=19bc6d869afe40c181459621c06b9057&_e=44UMpjbVgw1qk95lJ3OGW3VkHjiDTy8mJqkmHmNNiuiBjs9b0faCvQz994ewj0B-zCdQtrEC2KaB3KZCOUbEv8Iz1y90ss6qhW2cm6x4Y8GBjFYDuL0I_58KdVeluFhY5JC2eFib5NCo1JcXyVxPIllHkDo-FCKB9uiKsttUS7PwxGamIP245y8_PZg9DvIvM3D7R9PRtBdO1xY97bvuJ6-JlxUDzmjIiY7tPPAXOhBci4l9wcFn87xmxqhsrDkntgd8gOz0m_qOwtlBlAHcLd92T7Xn4kc7tcYe4qT-Tp7CM4Is8g5px3GLud51rCR4Mc8zyhszQKfJcZn_ISn0qAHNYsof9XprD-l-dlD-NGTMstxrIvGw8FqxJXbha2_yWAauvxTT94YPBJYnw5CrGS8rWvg79VDLQwgYumb_7jw%3D "AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
**But we didn’t stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left’s favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That’s right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don’t like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don’t agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That’s not happening in Florida. I’m not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn’t stopped the Left from attacking me. That’s why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they’ve gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we’re doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes – successes that look like common sense to average Americans – as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That’s why I need your help. That’s why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**
* **Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.**
* **Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.**
* **Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.**

The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.**

_No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down._

**I hope you’ll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us.** [I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=19bc6d869afe40c181459621c06b9057&_e=44UMpjbVgw1qk95lJ3OGW3VkHjiDTy8mJqkmHmNNiuiBjs9b0faCvQz994ewj0B-zCdQtrEC2KaB3KZCOUbEv8Iz1y90ss6qhW2cm6x4Y8GBjFYDuL0I_58KdVeluFhY5JC2eFib5NCo1JcXyVxPIllHkDo-FCKB9uiKsttUS7PwxGamIP245y8_PZg9DvIvM3D7R9PRtBdO1xY97bvuJ3iYCKsXJGY4_63XZC7MGIQzjaqjDxU_4pefM0Y0ZOIn06wR55E2BK8lOP6f_t7xQ0l9iZxX5my-wm1ZEpKtFt--OJ7wR3HTELOogbwgIP5NDojpqgZ7zhsp7-01Z4YZrY85V0SjDoj0TIr_H_Us6_3K342S2eERHubuvRMsmcYu0N3gkZyjoSkJaLf0YjF-pH3gRgmIG-jSa9VpkFYTftk%3D "I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.")

**Sincerely, __

subject: I need to reach my goal by midnight ⏳
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926955:6CCi66VkN:m:1:3317145305:32CACE9DA8C0D50D07B240B72ECAB19D:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926955:6CCi66VkN:m:1:3317145305:32CACE9DA8C0D50D07B240B72ECAB19D:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926955:6CCi66VkN:m:1:3317145305:32CACE9DA8C0D50D07B240B72ECAB19D:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926955:6CCi66VkN:m:1:3317145305:32CACE9DA8C0D50D07B240B72ECAB19D:r "4")
---

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60926955:6CCi66VkN:m:1:3317145305:32CACE9DA8C0D50D07B240B72ECAB19D:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**

Marco Rubio

Friend,

Years ago, when a male legislator told me that I couldn't make a difference because I was "just a mom in tennis shoes," I didn't let that stop me. I fought hard for my community and went on to serve as the first woman – and first mom – to represent Washington state in the U.S. Senate.
Ever since, I've been working to pass legislation that gives working families some breathing room and helps strengthen our economy – from lowering health care and child care costs to creating good-paying jobs.
But the facts are clear: We still have so much work ahead of us, and if we want to keep up our progress, we have to protect our Senate majority. **That's why Republicans are doing – and _spending_ – everything they can to retake control, and now Mitch McConnell and the GOP are targeting our race.**
**[We can't lose a single seat this November, friend. So I'm asking you directly: Will you chip in $5 or more right now – split between my campaign and Jacky Rosen's – to keep my seat and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48750060/359434945/-1231372446?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1919-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDRlNDQ0MC03ZDEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJ1Eh_fvJhDS1wxgl5hlMOhKgxSocrt1uYPXWsz0dPs=)**

Patty Murray

clean_body: Getting our message to every corner of this district will take a ton of resources. | | | Hey Peter, Part of what we have to accomplish is making sure every voter in TN-07 understands the unpopular, far-right positions (and votes) our opponent has taken during his time in the House of Representatives — how anti-LGBTQ, anti-abortion, and even anti-birth control his record has been. To do that, we need to have a lot of conversations. Getting our message to every corner of this district will take many more resources than we currently have. Our opponent may have millions in his personal bank account he can loan to his campaign, but we have people power. In our book, that's even more important. To be able to run against him we need to out-organize him. That's why our organizing program is so essential — Thank you for all that you do! Friends,
I asked Wiley if I could send an email for him because I want you to hear this from me:
He's going to win this race.
But it's going to be close. Very close.
The good news is that the political tide is turning nationally, and Wiley is perfectly positioned to make the most of it.
Why?
Two reasons:
First, Wiley is the hardest working candidate I've ever met. Period. The guy goes everywhere. He's always in motion. You just don't see that too often, and it's given him an accessibility and transparency that people truly respect - because you can't fake it. His energy is real.
Second, Bo Hines is wild. It's not an exaggeration to say he's Madison Cawthorn 2.0. Make a list of all the most extreme MAGA claims you can imagine and Bo Hines explicitly endorses all of them.
“The election was stolen.”
“Abortion should be outlawed everywhere and with no exceptions.”
Wiley deserves your support on his own merits - but he sure as heck deserves it as your strongest shield against someone like Bo Hines becoming a member of Congress.
I've already made a big donation to Wiley. I'm not asking you to match it - I'm just asking you to do what you can for him today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2208-q3-wn?refcode=220803-email]
This is going to be one of the biggest congressional races in the country, and your support could make a big difference.
Best,
Jeff
P.S. - As a gift, Wiley once gave me a nice bottle of olive oil. I put it in my car and left it there on a very hot day. It exploded and sprayed olive oil everywhere. The bottle cost $24 and I think it would be great if lots of folks gave $24 to commemorate the #oliveoilexplosion of 2022. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2208-q3-wn?refcode=220803-email]

Big news, Peter. **Pramila has won her primary in WA-7!**
Now, we are fully focused on re-electing Pramila in November, protecting our Democratic majority by supporting Democrats in tough, swing districts, and helping elect people-first progressives across the country so we can build support for Medicare for All and bold progressive change.

As Pramila’s work goes on, she continues to need your grassroots support to fight for us, our rights, our democracy, and a better country for all. Team Jayapal

body:
Friends,
Last night, the Senate passed the PACT Act, finally guaranteeing that veterans exposed to toxic burn pits will get the health care they deserve.
Kirsten has fought alongside veterans, their families, and advocacy groups for over five years to pass this legislation—tirelessly building bipartisan support for a bill that will save lives for generations to come.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/PACT%20Act.jpg]
But the PACT Act’s passage was never guaranteed.
Last week, Senate Republicans blocked the bill—just one month after it passed the Senate with over 80 votes.
Kirsten called BS [https://www.wwnytv.com/2022/07/29/gillibrand-blasts-gop-blocking-burn-pit-bill/] —joining veterans and advocates to hold the 25 Republicans who switched their votes accountable for a political stunt that put lives at risk.
http://www.wwnytv.com/2022/07/29/gillibrand-blasts-gop-blocking-burn-pit-bill/ [http://www.wwnytv.com/2022/07/29/gillibrand-blasts-gop-blocking-burn-pit-bill/]
For six days, veterans and their families camped outside the Capitol. Day or night, rain or shine, they vowed not to move until the Senate passed the bill.
Last night, the Senate voted on the legislation once again. This time, it passed by an overwhelming majority. [https://www.ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/news/2022/08/01/senate-pact-act-toxin-veteran-burn-pit-schumer-gillibrand-jon-stewart]
The PACT Act’s passage is a reminder that the toughest fights are always worth taking on. That Washington works best when Americans raise their voices and demand accountability. That you can achieve great things when you aren’t afraid to fail.
Thank you standing with Kirsten in this fight,
Stefanie
P.S. Kirsten treated many of the veterans and families who had camped outside the Capitol for more than five days to a round of drinks to celebrate their hard work and a well-earned victory. Take a look:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/FZMybwQXoAMm1s5.jpg]

subject: An Inspiring Endorsement
body:
Ret. Deputy Commanding General
| | | |

---
|
# Major General Vallely Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(August 2, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Major General Paul Vallely.

Major General Paul Vallely is a 1961 West Point graduate who retired as Deputy Commanding General for the US Army Pacific in 1991. A veteran of two combat tours in Vietnam, he is a graduate of the Industrial College of the Armed Forces as well as the Army War College.

Throughout his 32-year military career, Maj. Gen. Vallely served in many overseas theaters to include Europe and the Pacific Rim Countries. He has served on US security assistance missions on civilian-military relations to Europe, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Indonesia and Central America with in-country experience in Indonesia, Columbia, El Salvador, Panama, Honduras and Guatemala.

Vallely was nominated for Assistant Secretary of Defense for Special Operations under President Reagan. Vallely commanded the 351st Civil Affairs Command from 1982-1986, including all Special Forces, Psychological Warfare, and Civil Military units in the Western US and Hawaii. He developed and designed the Host Nation Support Program in the Pacific for the Department of Defense and the State Department.

Since his retirement from the military, Vallely has served as a military analyst for the FOX News Channel and is a guest on many nationally syndicated radio talk shows. He co-authored the book Endgame: The Blueprint for Victory in the War on Terror (2004).
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Maj. Gen. Paul Vallely said:
"Having served the U.S. Army for over 32 years in combat and peacetime, I know and recognize an experienced and capable leader like Erik Aadland. He is a West Point graduate who understands Duty, Honor, and Country. I am proud to share our alma mater, West Point and the Long Gray Line with him, and that shared tradition is one way I know that he will represent his constituents well. In this time of increasing challenges to our country, Erik will hit the ground running in Washington as an advocate for our citizens and will fight against corruption and lawlessness. He will work unceasingly to find and champion the right ideas for Coloradans. Erik has my strongest endorsement to become your representative from the 7th district to Congress."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am inspired and enthused by Major General (Ret.) Vallely's endorsement. It's an honor to earn the trust of a leader and thinker of his caliber. I share MG Vallely's concern about the severe issues facing our economy, public safety, energy, and educational systems, and I intend to fight for all Coloradans to resolve these crises. I appreciate the leadership that MG Vallely and his generation gave us during their time. I will continue that tradition by ably representing the 7th district in Washington."
---

---
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What we learned from our primary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220803&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220803&amount=28]
Friend,
The results from yesterday’s primary are in. I will officially be running against Tom Barrett to represent Michigan’s new 7th district in Congress.
Even though my race was uncontested, we’re true data nerds here on Team Slotkin – and as such, we had our campaign war room up and running at our headquarters, working late into the night, parsing through election results. I wanted to share a few of our initial takeaways:
Going into the night, we expected that there would be more votes overall in the Republican primary in our race than in the Democratic primary – that was the natural assumption, since the Republicans had a hotly contested primary for Governor at the top of the ticket, and the Democratic ticket, from Governor on down, was all unopposed.
And yet, our campaign received more overall votes than our opponent did last night – 77,207 to his 74,902.
Not surprisingly, we outran him in Ingham County, home to most of the city of Lansing. That’s an area that I currently represent in Michigan's 8th district.
But there was one county that really took us by surprise: in Eaton County, Tom Barrett’s home county that he currently represents in the Michigan Senate, I again got more votes than he did – and this is a county new to me in the re-drawn 7th district.
And it wasn’t just the more urban parts of Eaton County (the ones that fall within the city of Lansing) where I got more votes: I also outran my opponent in the city of Grand Ledge, and the more rural village of Dimondale.
We’re still going through the full results, but I wanted to at least share these initial results because they speak to what we’ve been hearing on the doors: voters are itching to get out to vote, to make their voices heard in some way, and our high turnout numbers point to that trajectory over the next 97 days.
We saw this last night in Kansas, where an overwhelming majority voted not to criminalize abortion in their state constitution. We’ll have a very similar opportunity on our ballots in Michigan this November, where we’ll be voting on a ballot proposal to enshrine the standard of Roe in our state constitution – given that we currently have a 1931 law on the books outlawing abortion.
For now, I’ll leave you with this: service is the greatest love letter you can write to your country. I’m grateful for the opportunity to represent the folks of mid-Michigan, and I thank you for being along for this ride with me.

On to November!
Elissa

Beto will make sure our schools are fully funded.
#
We want to share something we're really proud of.
During the last Texas Ethics Commission reporting period, teachers were Beto's top contributors by occupation. And there's one reason for that — instead of attacking teachers, Beto will be a governor who has their backs.
**It's time that we step up for our educators.[Please, if you're with us in our movement to ensure world-class public schools in every community, will you chip in $3 now to support Beto's campaign for governor?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220803-1.Km1w-O&refcode=ema20220803-201425&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=201425%2E444211%2EYxCD9T)**
Under Greg Abbott, Texas teachers have been underpaid, undersupported, and underappreciated for far too long. We're going to change that by implementing bipartisan, commonsense solutions for education.
Here's what's in Beto's plan:
✅ Fully funding public schools
✅ Raising teacher pay to *at least* the national average
✅ Strengthening health and retirement benefits
✅ Ending the over-reliance on standardized testing
In contrast, Abbott's only plan for education seems to be defunding our schools: taking our tax dollars _out_ of public schools and sending them away from our communities. With these constant attacks, it's no surprise that 68% of teachers seriously considered leaving the profession in the last year.
**As governor, Beto will make sure our schools are fully funded and that our hard-working teachers are paid what they deserve.** But there's only one way we can do that — by removing Abbott from power.

CHIPS will be signed into law August 9th because there were enough senators willing to protect this country, but not Senator Hoeven. It is so important for our party to become an electoral threat to restore balance, the rule of law and what makes ND so special. The state bank, the state mill, are examples of our collective commitment to each other and the future. I am committed to working to insure a bright future for the state and the people in it. I am an agricultural engineer and educator. I have been working to solve problems for a long time. I care about people and this state. Help me amplify that message and donate today.

| | Peter, Congratulations to Congresswoman Haley Stevens, who ran a strong campaign and will be the Democratic nominee for Michigan’s new 11th District. I will support her and work with her and others to elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Oakland County and across Michigan and the United States on November 8. **We came up short in this primary election — but I still couldn’t be more proud of this team, and I couldn’t be more grateful for everything you’ve done.** This has been a truly people-powered campaign — from the over 300 volunteers who knocked on 73,519 doors and the 500 volunteers who made 238,963 calls to every person who sent a postcard, put up a yard sign, chipped in with a donation, and so many more behind the scenes efforts. Together, we locked arms and worked side by side with enthusiasm and grit to engage our communities, answer the tough questions head on and build a multi-racial, working class movement dedicated to creating a more just world. From the bottom of my heart, thank you. Unfortunately, I was also the target of a largely Republican-funded campaign set on defeating the movement I represent no matter where I ran. I am humbled by neighbors throughout Oakland County and friends new and old across the country who stepped up to help me fight back until the very last minute. I will continue to speak out against the corrosive influence of dark money on our democracy. And until the very last second I’m in office as a House member, I’ll continue pulling every lever I can find to improve the lives of working families. But I won’t stop there. This campaign was never just about one election. It was never about which person gets to have which title. It’s about the future we’re all building together, and the power we each have in our democracy. **I was an organizer before I got to Congress. I’ve been an organizer inside Congress. And I’m going to be an organizer after I leave Congress. My life’s work has been to fight for justice, no matter my job title, and that won’t stop.** We’re at a moment in history when we need everyone off the sidelines and in the streets fighting for workers rights, abortion rights, racial justice, climate action and all the progress we need. I will keep up the fight with pride. And I’m so grateful to be on this team with you. Thank you for everything. Onward,

clean_body: I couldn’t be more proud of this team, and I couldn’t be more grateful for everything you’ve done for this truly people-powered campaign. | | | | | Peter, Congratulations to Congresswoman Haley Stevens, who ran a strong campaign and will be the Democratic nominee for Michigan’s new 11th District. I will support her and work with her and others to elect Democrats up and down the ballot in Oakland County and across Michigan and the United States on November 8. We came up short in this primary election — but I still couldn’t be more proud of this team, and I couldn’t be more grateful for everything you’ve done. This has been a truly people-powered campaign — from the over 300 volunteers who knocked on 73,519 doors and the 500 volunteers who made 238,963 calls to every person who sent a postcard, put up a yard sign, chipped in with a donation, and so many more behind the scenes efforts. Together, we locked arms and worked side by side with enthusiasm and grit to engage our communities, answer the tough questions head on and build a multi-racial, working class movement dedicated to creating a more just world. From the bottom of my heart, thank you. Unfortunately, I was also the target of a largely Republican-funded campaign set on defeating the movement I represent no matter where I ran. I am humbled by neighbors throughout Oakland County and friends new and old across the country who stepped up to help me fight back until the very last minute. I will continue to speak out against the corrosive influence of dark money on our democracy. And until the very last second I’m in office as a House member, I’ll continue pulling every lever I can find to improve the lives of working families. But I won’t stop there. This campaign was never just about one election. It was never about which person gets to have which title. It’s about the future we’re all building together, and the power we each have in our democracy. I was an organizer before I got to Congress. I’ve been an organizer inside Congress. And I’m going to be an organizer after I leave Congress. My life’s work has been to fight for justice, no matter my job title, and that won’t stop. We’re at a moment in history when we need everyone off the sidelines and in the streets fighting for workers rights, abortion rights, racial justice, climate action and all the progress we need. I will keep up the fight with pride. And I’m so grateful to be on this team with you. Thank you for everything. | Peter,

It’s Josh Riley, and I hope you’re doing well. I’ll admit something to you most candidates won’t: raising money was the part of this job I was least prepared to do.

_Asking for money is totally awkward and not how I was raised._

But, I have to tell you — I’m so proud of the success that we’ve had as a campaign. Since the day we launched last November, we’ve raised more money than any other Democratic House candidate across all of Upstate New York, and we’ve done it with a grassroots movement that I’m really proud of:
* Over half of our contributions are $25 or less;
* Over two-thirds of our contributions are $50 or less;

**And here’s the best part: On Monday, we set a fundraising record for our campaign with over 1,000 contributions in a single day! The average contribution was just $13.**

It’s incredible and deeply humbling to see the outpouring of support for our vision for Upstate New York.

Now, as our team emailed you yesterday, we have our pre-primary FEC deadline at midnight tonight. I just got off the phone with our Finance Director, and she let me know we are just **37 supporters away** from our 100 email contributions pre-primary report goal!

subject: We’re not done fighting for abortion rights

body:
I don’t usually send you emails about Kansas.
#
Derek,
I don’t usually send you emails about Kansas. But something *very* special happened there yesterday.
**In a show of force at the ballot box, Kansas voters overwhelmingly REJECTED a constitutional amendment to remove protections of abortion rights.**
Protecting women’s reproductive rights in a red state like Kansas is a big deal, Derek.
Sadly, the PA GOP is trying to do the same thing here + create abortion bans here in the Commonwealth.
**But people are fired up and ready to fight against their rights taken away by far-right extremists on the Supreme Court and in Congress.**
[**_Derek, I am side-by-side with voters in PA, KS, and nationwide in the fight for abortion rights. Make a donation of any amount today to help us win this race + flip this seat, and I’ll vote to codify Roe v. Wade and protect women’s reproductive freedom._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220803-2?refcode=em20220803-6736&refcode2=6736_434096_tActT6&akid=6736%2E434096%2EtActT6)
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220803-2?refcode=em20220803-6736&refcode2=6736_434096_tActT6&akid=6736%2E434096%2EtActT6)**
But really, I couldn’t be more serious. Everyone should have power over their own bodies + own lives. I’ll say it again + again + again, and when you send me to the U.S. Senate, I’ll proudly cast the 51st vote Democrats need to protect the right to choose.
_I will protect abortion rights. Dr. Oz will take them away.**It’s that simple. And our race here in PA could determine control of the U.S. Senate.**_
[**_The stakes are too high to leave anything to chance in PA. Please chip in any donation you can to help me flip this seat + protect abortion access from the GOP._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220803-2?refcode=em20220803-6736&refcode2=6736_434096_tActT6&akid=6736%2E434096%2EtActT6)
With the stakes this high, there’s no other team I’d want to have on my side. Thanks for being part of this, Derek. 🙏
Thank you,
—John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
